response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa akwai matsala ta hanyar numfashi (respiratory issue) wadda ba cutar TB ba, kamar yadda gwajin ya nuna. question: Likita, na kawo yarona mai shekaru biyar da watanni biyu, wanda yake fama da wannan rashin lafiyar kimanin watanni biyu yanzu, wanda yake samun wahalar numfashi da daddare kuma yana tari a kowane lokaci. question: Na lura cewa ƙanwata, wadda a da take yawan dariya da farin ciki kuma tana wasa da ƙawayenta, ta canza kwatsam. Yanzu kullum tana zama ita kaɗai a ɗakinta. response: Wannan yanayin da ka bayyana, musamman canjin launin idanu da fata zuwa kalan kwai tare da zafi da rawa, yana nuna akasin yanayin cutar 'Yellow Fever' ko kuma wata cutar kwaɗau (Jaundice) da ke shafar kiwon tsadar jiki. question: Barka da yamma na zo ne saboda ƙannena. Na lura cewa idanunsa da fatarsa suna da wani... canjin launi fari-fari/kalan kwai Kuma wannan abun yana faruwa kusan kwanaki uku yanzu. response: Yana da matukar muhimmanci a kai yaron asibiti nan take domin magajin mai maganin gargajiya ya haddasa masa ciwon cuta (infection) ta hanyar yanka da shafa abubuwa ba tare da tsafta ba. A asibiti, za a yi masa gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) da gwajin sauran kwayoyin cuta (Culture) domin gano nau'in kwayar cutar da ke haddasa kumburin. Yaron ba zai kamu da hauka ta kare ba domin cizon ba shi da alaƙa da hauka, amma cutar da aka yi masa a wajen cizon na iya yin hadari idan ba a magance ta ba. question: Wani ɗan uwa na ya kawo yaronsa mai shekara bakwai bayan kare ya cije shi. Da kare ya cije shi, sai suka kai shi wurin mai maganin gargajiya. response: Wannan hali na tari mai tsanani tare da gajiya da wahalar numfashi yana nuna akwai matsala da jikin yana samun ƙarfin numfashi, wanda yawanci yana da alaƙa da cututtukan huhu (kamar chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) ko cututtukan zuciya (kamar heart failure). Ba wai kawai huhu ko zuciya ba ne ke haddasa haka; cututtukan kwayoyin halitta, matsalar jini, ko kuma matsalar kwayar mahaifa (anemia) na iya kawo wadannan alamomi da kuma mutuwa idan ba a yi magance su ba. Alamomin haɗari da suka shafe kowane lokaci su ne: yawan tari da numfashi lokacin kwancewa, canjin launin fuska ko labu zuwa shudi, tsananin wahalar numfashi da ke sa mutum ya kasa magana, da kuma yawan kwanciya saboda rashin ikon tafiya. Idan mutum ya fara yin wadannan alamomin, dole ne a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin samun kulawar numfashi da kuma bincike na gaggawa.
question:

response: Wannan yanayin jaririn yana nuna cewa yana da matsalar numfashi mai tsanani (severe respiratory distress) wanda ya iya kasancewa sakamakon cutar numfashin (pneumonia) ko kuma matsalar hanci (croup/nasal obstruction). Dole ne ki kai jaririn asibiti nan da yanzu domin ya samu bincike da magungunan numfashin da ke rage kumburi da sauran cututtukan numfashin na yau da kullum. Kada ki yi amfani da ruwan zafi ko kowane magani na gida don magance numfashin domin hakan na iya kara masa haɗari idan matsalar ta fi kima. A asibiti, za a ba shi magungunan rage kumburi (nebulization) da kuma magungunan cutar numfashin wadanda ke da tasiri sosai. Karatun jariri yana da wuya, don haka ganin likita cikin gaggawa shi ne mafi mahimmanci domin tabbatar da cewa jaririn zai ci gaba da numfashi yadda ya kamata.

response: Wannan matacciya tana fama da matsalolin ke da alaƙa da yanayin jin daɗin zuciya (anxiety) da kuma tsorin bincike (PTSD) sakamakon cutar da take fama da shi daga mijinta. response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana da matsalar numfashi mai tsanani wadda take nuna akwai sauti (wheezing) da kuma sukar karkashin ƙirji (retractions), wanda ke nuna cewa numfashinsa yana da wahala sosai. response: Wannan matan tana da alamomin da suka fi nuna cewa naƙuda (ectopic pregnancy) ne, musamman saboda ciwon cikinta, fitar da jini, da kuma kihin da ba ya tsayawa. Naƙuda yana faru ne lokacin da ƙuraɗin juna ya zama a wani sashe na jikin mahaifiya in ba cikin mahaifiyance ba, wanda hakan na iya haddasa hatsari ga rayuwar mace idan ya fito daga jiki. Shi kuma cikin da ya lalace (miscarriage) yawanci yana zuwa da zafi mai tsanani da fitar da jini mai yawa a lokacin da juna ya riga ya girma. Dole ne a ba mata shawarar zuwa asibiti cikin gaggawa don yin hoton ciki (ultrasound) domin tabbatar da inda ƙuraɗin juna yake. Mun tambaye ta wata nawa take da ciki, sai ta ce tana da ciki na wata shida da wasu kwanaki.

Tambayarmu ga likita ita ce: Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa nakuda ta fara ne kafin lokaci (haihuwa da wuri), ko kuma suna iya nuna cewa cikin ya lalace (zubar da ciki), ko kuwa wata matsala ce daban? response: A gabanin wannan yanayin, ba za a iya ba uwar magani don ta yi wa jaririyar a gida ba, domin jaririyar tana fama da wahalar numfashi (respiratory distress) wanda alamar cuta ce mai tsanani. Wannan hali na hauhawa da saƙon numfashi yana nuna cewa jaririyar tana bukatar ganin likita nan take don a tantance ko akwai kumburin numfashi, cutar numfashi ta kwayar cuta (pneumonia), ko wani matsayin daji. Ba da maganin tari kawai ba zai iya kashewa, domin matsalar jaririyar ba tari ba ne kawai, face matsalar numfashi ce wadda ke bukatar magungunan na gaggawa kamar oxygen ko magungunan da za su rage kumburi. Ya kamata a fara cikakken duba jaririyar (physical examination) domin sanin matakin cutar da kuma yin allura ko magungunan gaggawa a asibiti. Dole ne a raba jaririyar zuwa sashen gaggawa (emergency) domin samu da kulawar da ta dace cikin sauri.
question:
Wata mata ta haihu a asibitinmu kimanin watanni shida da suka gabata. Yanzu ta dawo asibitin tare da mijinta da jaririyarsu mai watanni shida.
Mahaifiyar ta bayyana cewa kimanin kwanaki goma sha uku zuwa goma sha huɗu da suka gabata ne ta fara lura cewa jaririyar ta fara tari. Ta kuma ce tun kafin tari ya fara, tana yi wa jaririyar maganin mura.
Ta ce tun jiya tari ya ƙara tsananta sosai. Duk da cewa tari ya fara ƙaruwa tun kusan kwanaki uku da suka gabata, amma tun jiya ya zama mai tsanani ƙwarai.
Ta ce duk lokacin da take shayar da jaririyar nono, tana kuma ba ta wani maganin tari na ruwa da ake sayarwa a cikin kwalba, wanda take ci gaba da ba ta.
Sai ta ƙara da cewa tun daga jiya, tari ya yi tsanani matuƙa har ya sa jaririyar tana fama sosai wajen numfashi. Numfashinta yana kamar yana hauhawa da saukowa cikin ƴan daƙiƙu kaɗan-kaɗan, abin da ya tayar musu da hankali ƙwarai.
Saboda tsananin fargaba ne suka kawo jaririyar asibiti.
Tambaya ita ce: Shin za mu iya ba wannan uwa wani magani da za ta ba jaririyar a gida, alhali tana fama da wahalar numfashi tare da wannan tari? Shin ya dace mu rubuta mata maganin tari kawai, ko kuwa ya kamata a fara cikakken duba jaririyar kafin a rubuta kowane irin magani ko a yi mata allura?

response: Wannan hali na tari mai tsanani da ya karya numfashi na iya faruwa saboda cututtuka irin su asharin numfashi (asthma), cututtukan zuciya, ko kuma kumburin hanyoyin numfashi sakamakon cututtuka kamar pneumonia. Za a yi wa yaron gwajin saurin numfashi (peak flow), gwajin jini ko kwararar iska, da kuma sauraron saurin bugun zuciya da numfashi don gano matsalar. Maganin ya dogara da cutar, amma yawanci ana amfani da magungunan rage kumburi (bronchodilators) da na kiyaye numfashi. Ya kamata a kai yaron asibiti nan da nan domin samun tallafin numfashi (oxygen) da kuma maganin gaggawa don kare rayuwarsa. Shawara gare mai kula da shi ita ce ya guji abubuwan da ke tada tari, kamar wuta ko kura, kuma ya bibi tsarin magungin da likita ya ba shi.
question: Wani mai kula da yaro ya lura cewa yaron yana tari mai tsanani, har tari yana katse masa numfashi kuma yana fama da wahalar numfashi. Me zai iya sa yaro ya yi irin wannan tari mai tsanani har ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata? Wadanne gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa wannan yaro domin gano matsalar? Wane irin magani ne za a ba shi? Kuma wace shawara ce ya kamata a ba mai kula da wannan yaro?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa mijinta yana da matsalar kiwon lafiya mai tsanani wadda ke bukatar ganin likita cikin gaggawa (emergency) domin ciwon kai mai matuƙar muni da taurin wuya na iya zama alamun ciwon jijiyoyin kwakwalwa (stroke) ko baraziyar kwakwalwa. Kurajen da suka bayyana da taurin wuya na iya nuna cututtuka kamar rashin jin dadin jiki (meningitis) ko kuma cututtukan numfashi da ke shafar jijiyoyin jiki. Matar ta kamata ta kai mijinta asibiti nan da yanzu don a yi masa gwajin kwakwalwa da jijiyoyi domin tabbatar da lafiyarsa. Kar ka ba shi kowane irin maganin gargajiya ko maganin ciwon kai a gida saboda hakan na iya ƙara haddasa matsalar. Tabbatar da cewa yana samun iska da ruwa yadda ya kamata yayin da ake jiran ganin likita.
question: Wata mata ta lura cewa mijinta yana da ciwon kai, kuma ciwon kan yana da matukar muni da ban tsoro da gaske. Ya kai matakin da mutumin yake da taurin wuya wanda ba zai iya juyar da shi hagu ko dama ba kamar yadda ya kamata. Yanzu ta lura da wasu kananan kuraje wadanda da babu su a jikin mutumin amma suka bayyana ba zato ba tsammani. Wannan ya tsoratar da matar cewa irin wannan abu da ya faru da mijinta mene ne zai iya haddasa shi kuma me za ta iya yi? Tambayar da na yi wa matar ita ce, ko mijinta ya taba yin zazzabi mai zafi kuma aka yi amfani da wani irin magani? Ta ce a'a. Ko kuma mutumin, gadon da yake kwanciya a kai abin da yake amfani da shi a matsayin matashin kai begen muna kada ya kasance ya kwanta ba daidai ba ne ya murgude wuyansa, matar ta ce a'a ba wai ya kwanta ba daidai ba ne ya murgude wuyansa ba, amma ciwon kan ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani kuma yana tafiya tare da taurin wuya da kananan kuraje a jiki. Idan wani abu mai kama da wannan ya faru, me irin wannan mata za ta iya yi don taimakawa wajen kula da mijinta kuma ya dawo cikin koshin lafiyarsa na da?

response: Waɗannan alamomin da Mijina yake da su, kamar yawan shan ruwa (polydipsia), yawan yin fitsari (polyuria), jin gajiya, da kuma lalacewar gani, suna nuna alamomin ciwon sukari (Diabetes Mellitus) sosai. Saboda ƙarancin sinadarin insulin ko rashin samar da shi, jiki ba zai iya amfani da sukari a matsayin makamashin ƙarfi ba, wanda hakan ke sa jiki yin fitsari don fitar da ƙarin sukari da ke cikin jini. Yawan fitsari yana sa jikin rasa ruwa, wanda ke haddasa ƙishirwa da kuma jinin ƙarfin gani idan jini ya yi ƙarancin ruwa. Ya kamata Mijina ya je asibiti nan da zarar domin a yi masa gwajin ƙarancin sukari a jini (Fast Blood Sugar) da gwajin sukari a cikin kwamoshi (HbA1c), tare da gwajin sarin jini. Ya kamata ya rage cin abinci mai ƙarin sukari da fatar kaza, ya ƙarfafa cin kayan lambu da sinadarin ruwa, kuma ya tabbatar da bin shawarar likita don kauce wa haɗarin lalacewar ƙwayar idaniya ko kway
question:
Mijina yana da shekara arba'in, kuma kwatsam na lura cewa kusan tsawon makonni uku da suka wuce yana shan ruwa fiye da kima. Yayin da yake ƙara shan ruwa, haka kuma yake yawan yin fitsari. A gaskiya ma, da daddare yana iya tashi har sau goma kafin gari ya waye domin yin fitsari. Ya kuma dinga korafin cewa kullum yana jin gajiya. Haka kuma ya ɗan ƙara nauyi. Wani lokaci idanunsa sukan yi masa duhu, kuma yana cewa ba ya gani sosai idan ya tashi ya fara tafiya. Na lura cewa yana yin fitsari da yawa sosai kuma akai-akai.
Me zai iya haifar da wannan yawan yin fitsari da kuma ƙishirwa mai tsanani? Me ya sa yake shan ruwa da yawa amma kuma yana yawan yin fitsari haka? Shin waɗannan alamomin na iya nuna cewa yana da ciwon sukari , ko kuwa suna iya nuna wata cuta dabam?
Wadanne irin gwaje-gwajen likita ya kamata a yi masa domin a gano ainihin abin da ke faruwa? Me ya sa yake jin gajiya kullum? Me ke jawo yawan yin fitsarin? Shin hawan jini na iya haifar da irin waɗannan alamomin, ko kuwa rashin ruwa a jiki ne, ko wata cuta dabam?
Wadanne irin abinci da abubuwan sha ya kamata ya guje musu, kuma wadanne ya kamata a ƙarfafa masa ya ci ko ya sha? Wadanne matakai ya kamata ya ɗauka domin waɗannan alamomin su ragu ko su daina? Shin yana buƙatar zuwa asibiti domin a yi masa gwaje-gwaje, ko kuwa ba lallai ba ne?
Sau nawa ya kamata a rika yin gwajin ciwon sukari ko gwajin sikarin jini—akai-akai ne ko kuma lokaci-lokaci kawai? Wadanne cututtuka ne za su iya zama sanadin duk waɗannan alamomin da suke bayyana a jikinsa?

response: Jaririyar tana cikin yanayi mai hadari, amma akwai damar ta rayu idan an samar mata da iskar oxygen da kulawar gaggawa domin magance matsalar numfashi. Matsalar numfashi tana nuna cewa jaririyar ta samu matsalar zagayen jini ko kuma kwayoyin halitta da ke dauke da oxygen (surfactant) sun yi karancin da ya kamata. Idan an samu kyakkyawar kulawa nan take, tana da damar samun lafiya, amma yiwuwar samun nakasa (disability) ya danganta da yawan lokacin da ta shafe ba tare da iska ba. Dole ne a bibiyar yanayin sa ne daidai domin ganin yadda keɓe da kuma yadda za a kare ta daga nakasa mai dorewa. Kuma yana da kyau a tabbatar ana bibiyar ta a asibiti domin magance duk wata matsala da za ta iya faruwa cikin gaggawa.
question: Na kai wata kawata mai juna biyu mai shekara goma sha takwas zuwa asibiti domin naƙudarta ta kama, kuma lokacin haihuwarta ya yi. Da muka isa asibitin, bayan likitoci sun gudanar da dukkan gwaje-gwajen da suka dace, sai aka gano cewa hawan jininta ya yi yawa. Bayan an kammala duk abin da ya kamata a yi, naƙudarta ta ci gaba. Ta shafe kusan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda. Mijinta yana kusa, sai likitoci suka ba da shawarar cewa ta amince a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa saboda ta daɗe sosai tana naƙuda. Amma kawata ta ƙi. Ta ce, "A'a, ko kaɗan. Ina so in haihu ta hanyar farji kamar matan Ibraniyawa." Daga ƙarshe ta haihu. Bayan awa goma sha biyu tana naƙuda, ta haifi jaririya mace mai kama da lafiyayyiya, kuma muka gode wa Allah. Amma abin da ya ba mu mamaki shi ne, jaririyar ba ta numfashi yadda ya kamata. Ma'aikatan lafiya suka ci gaba da motsa ta ta hanyar shafawa da dukan bayanta a hankali. Ta yi kuka, amma har yanzu numfashinta bai daidaita ba. Nan da nan suka ba ta iskar oxygen. Likita, don Allah, wannan jaririya za ta rayu kuwa? Kuma idan ta rayu, shin ba za ta iya samun nakasa ba?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana fama da cutar numfashi (respiratory infection), wadda yawanci take da zaune a ƙasarmu saboda kwayoyin cuta ko ƙura. Tari mai tsanani da wahalar numfashi suna faruwa ne saboda kumburin hanyoyin numfashi ko namijin sosai (mucus) da ke hana iska shigowa cikin sauƙi. Wannan yana sa yaro ya yi wahalar yin numfashi domin huhu ko kwayoyin cuta sun rage yadda huhun yake aiki. Ya kamata a kai yaron asibiti cikin gaggawa don a ba shi magungunan rage kumburi, maganin tari, da kuma kuma a tabbatar yana samun iska mai yawa. Idan yaron ya fara yin launin fuska ko ya daina yin kuka, dole ne a samar masa da iskar {oxygen} nan take don ceton rayuwarsa.
question:
Wata mai kula da ƙaramin yaro ta lura cewa yaron da take kulawa yana fama da wahalar numfashi, kuma numfashinsa ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. Ta kuma lura cewa yaron yana ta yin tari akai-akai, kuma tari ne mai tsanani.
Yaron ba jariri ba ne da aka watsar tun yana haihuwa, kuma ba yaro ba ne da ake yi wa wanka da ruwan sanyi. To, me ne zai iya jawo wa ƙaramin yaro wahalar numfashi da tari mai tsanani, kuma me ya sa numfashin yaron ba zai kasance cikin sauƙi kamar yadda ya kamata ba? Mene ne ya kamata a yi domin taimaka wa yaron a wannan yanayin?

response: Wannan hali na tari ba tare da tsayawa ba tare da wahalar numfashi, musamman da dare, yana nuna cewa yaron na iya kasancewa da matsalar numfashi (asthma) ko kuma wata cutar da ke shafar hanyoyin numfashi. Wahalar numfashi da kuma sautin kirji na nuna cewa hanyoyin numfashi sun kumbura ko sun cika da mucus, wanda ke sa yaro ya kasa samun iska yadda ya kamata. Alamomin haɗari da ya kamata a lura da su sun hada da canjin launin fuska ko murmushin yaro zuwa kurkure, numfashi mai tsanani (retractions), ko kuma yaron ya kasa yin magana sakamakon rashin iska. Dole ne a guji abubuwan da ke sa tari kamar hadin zuwa kura, hayar mota, kwayoyin cuta, ko kuma yanayin daɗin da yake sa yaro ya yi tari. Ya kamata a kai yaron asibiti nan da gaggawa don ba shi magungunan da za su buɗe hanyoyin numfashinsa da kuma siyan kariya.
question: Wata uwa ta lura cewa tun kwanaki da suka gabata, ɗanta ya fara yin tari ba tare da tsayawa ba. Da farko, ta yi tunanin mura ce ta kama masa ƙirji kuma za ta warke da kanta. Amma tari bai ragu ba. Kowace dare, yaron yana farkawa ba zato saboda tsananin tari. Wasu lokutan kuma yana wahalar numfashi, kamar yana fama da rashin samun iska yadda ya kamata. Uwar kan ɗauke shi ta zaunar da shi a tsaye, sannan tana jin ƙirjinsa na yin ƙara yayin da yake numfashi. Wannan yana hana yaron yin barci cikin kwanciyar hankali da dare. Wata rana, bayan dare da yaron ya yi tari mai tsanani kuma ya yi fama da wahalar numfashi, uwar ta yanke shawarar kai shi asibiti. Ta so ta san abin da ke haddasa tari, abin da ke jawo wahalar numfashi, da kuma yadda za ta taimaka wa yaron. Tambayata ita ce: Mene ne zai iya sa yaro ya yi tari mai tsanani tare da wahalar numfashi, musamman da dare? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata a lura da su idan yaro yana tari? Kuma waɗanne abubuwa ya kamata a guje musu domin hana ko rage wannan tari?

response: Zuciyar mace mai juna biyu na iya bugawa da sauri saboda ƙarancin jini (anemia), canjin sinadarin jiki, ko kuma matsinin da ke tasiri akan zuciya. Kumburin wuya na iya nuna matsalar sinadarin jiki ko kuma ciwon suga, wanda idan ba a magance ba, zai iya shafar girman jariri da kuma hasashensa. Alamomin haɗari da ya kamata a kula da su sun hada da rashin iya yin katse ko kwararar fenti, faduwa, da kuma rage yawan yawan kuka ko jijiyoyin jariri. Ya kamata ta rage cin abinci mai yawan gishiri da fatar daniya, sannan ta kara cin abinci mai ƙarfi kamar kayan lambu da sinadarin ƙarfe don magance ƙarancin jini. Tabbatan lafiya a asibiti da yin gwajin jini da suga shi ne mafi mahimmanci don tabbatar da lafiyar ita da jaririnta.
question:
Wata mata mai juna biyu mai ciki wata shida da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai, kamar mutum da ya gama gudu. Wani lokaci kuma tana jin gajiya sosai ba tare da ta yi wani aiki ba, sannan hannayenta suna ɗan rawa kaɗan.
Bayan wasu makonni, ta kuma lura cewa wuyanta ya fara kumbura a gaba. Da mutane suka fara gaya mata cewa wuyanta ya canza kuma ya kumbura fiye da da, sai ta tsorata ƙwarai. Ta fara tunanin ko wannan wata cuta ce da ke shafar mata masu juna biyu ko kuwa wata matsala ce dabam. Yanzu ta yanke shawarar zuwa ganin likita domin a gano abin da ke jawo wannan matsala.
Tambayata ita ce: Me zai iya sa zuciyar mace mai juna biyu ta rika bugawa da sauri kamar wadda ta gama gudu, tare da kumburin wuya? Wannan matsalar na iya shafar girma da ci gaban jaririn da ke cikin cikinta? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata su rika sa ido a kansu a gida? Shin akwai wasu abinci ko abubuwan sha da ya kamata ta guje musu, ko kuma waɗanda ya kamata ta fi ci da sha a wannan lokaci?

response: Wannan matsala na iya faruwa saboda matsalolin jini (Uterine Fibroids), cututtukan matatalar jiki (Pregnancy complications), ko kuma matsalar kwayar jini (Menorrhagia/Endometrial issues). Matakan gaggawa sun hada da ba ta ruwan sanyi (IV fluids) don mayar da jinin da ta rasa, da kuma ba ta magungunan rage jini (Tranexamic Acid) ko magungunan rage kwayar jini (Antifibrinolytics). Dole ne a yi gwajin jini (CBC) don duba yawan kwayar jini da kuma gwajin daidai ko akwai ciki (Urine Pregnancy Test) don sanin dalilin asalin matsalar. Idan matsalar ta ci gaske, ana iya yin lasisi (Laparoscopy) ko sarrafa jini ta hanyar magunguna ko kirki (Surgery) dangane da abin da gwajin ya nuna. Muhimmin mataki shine kula da yanayin jini da kuma tabbatar da cewa ba ta jin raunin barin ciki ba kafin a yanke shawara.
question:
An kawo wata mata asibiti da safiyar yau saboda tana zubar da jini mai yawa, kuma hakan ya jawo mata matsananciyar damuwa. An tambaye ta ko wannan ya taɓa faruwa da ita a baya, sai ta ce eh, ya taɓa faruwa kusan sau biyu, inda take jin ciwo sannan zubar jinin yana zuwa lokaci-lokaci.
Daga nan aka tambaye ta ko tana iya yin ɓarin ciki, amma ta ce ba ta san ko tana da ciki ko kuwa ta taɓa samun ciki ba. An kuma tambaye ta yaushe ne ta yi al'ada ta ƙarshe, sai ta ce ba da daɗewa ba ne, domin ta yi al'ada kusan wata ɗaya da rabi da ya wuce kafin wannan zubar jinin ya sake farawa da safiyar yau.
Don Allah, me ne zai iya sa mace ta yi irin wannan zubar jini mai yawa? Waɗanne matakan gaggawa za a iya ɗauka? Waɗanne magunguna ko hanyoyin jinya za a iya ba ta domin ceton rayuwarta da dakatar da zubar jinin? Waɗanne magunguna ko allurai masu taimakawa wajen rage ko dakatar da zubar jini za a iya fara ba ta? Kuma waɗanne gwaje-gwaje za a iya yi domin gano ainihin abin da ke haifar da irin wannan tsananin zubar jini?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana da matsalar "Congenital Anomaly" wajen kewayen baki (Cleft Lip/Palate) wanda ke hana shi shan nono yadda ya kamata, sannan kuma yana da matsalar numfashi (Respiratory Distress). Kore-kore a leben jariri yana nuna akwai rashin daidai a cikin jikin jaririn, wanda zai iya kasancewa sakamakon cutar da take da shi ko kuma wani ciwon jinina. Saboda jaririn yana fafutuka da samun wahalar numfashi, wannan yana da hadari sosai ga rayuwarsa kuma yana bukatar ganin likita nan take don bincike. Ba za a iya ba da magani kawai ba; dole ne a yi bincike na cikaki (Clinical Examination) domin tabbatar da dalilin rashin numfashi da kuma yadda za a yi tsarin kula da baki da kuma cin abinci. Abin da ya fi mahimmanci shi ne a samar da hanyar da jaririn zai iya samun abinci da numfashi cikin sauƙi yayin da ake kula da lafiyarsa.
question:
Wata uwa daga cikin iyayen da galibi suke kawo jariransu don yin alluran rigakafi ta bayyana cewa ta lura jaririnta sabon haihuwa yana da matsala a kewayen baki, kuma leɓun jaririn suna bayyana da ɗan kore-kore 
Yau kuma, ta lura cewa lokacin da take ba jaririn nono, jaririn yana fafutuka, yana hucin neman iska, kuma yana samun wahalar yin numfashi yadda ya kamata. Ta ce wannan ne abun da ya sa ta damu domin ba ta san abin da ke faruwa da jaririn ba.
Mene ne zai iya sa leɓun sabon jariri bayyana da ɗan kore-kore  Mene ne kuma zai iya sa jariri fafutuka da samun wahalar yin numfashi lokacin da yake shan nono? Shin za a iya bayar da magani, ko kuwa ya kamata a binciki jaririn ne

response: Wannan hali da mace ke fama da shi, wanda ya hada da yawan zubar jini, fari da jiki, da kuma sanyi, yana nuna cewa ta shiga yanayin "Hypovolemic Shock" sakamakon asarar jini da yawa (Postpartum Hemorrhage). Akwai yiwuwar rashin tsabta da kyau bayan haihuwa ya haddasa kwayoyin cuta (infection), wanda ke kara sa jiki yin rawar sanyi da zafi, amma asharin jini ne babban dalilin fadin jiki da rawar sanyi. A halin yanzu, mara lafiya tana bukatar kulawa ta gaggawa ta hanyar saka "IV fluids" da kuma jinin da aka samu (blood transfusion) don mayar da jikinta da karfi. Ba zan iya rubuta allura ko magani ba domin wannan yanayi yana bukatar ganin likita a asibiti don daukar matakan gaggawa na kare rayuwarta. Shiga asibiti ne mafi kyawun mataki domin tsammani da kuma magani na gaggawa.
question:
Wata kaka ta lura cewa 'yarta, wadda ta haihu kwana uku da suka wuce, tana fama da zubar jini bayan haihuwa fiye da yadda ake tsammani. Ta kuma lura cewa jikinta ya fara yin fari sosai; hannayenta, ƙafafunta, fuskarta da kunnuwanta duk sun yi fari. Tana rawar sanyi kuma jikinta yana da zafi. Sai dai a cikin kwanaki ukun nan, ta lura cewa hannaye da ƙafafunta sun yi sanyi ƙwarai, kuma ta gaji matuƙa har ba ta iya yin komai. Wannan ne ya sa ta kawo ta asibiti domin likita ya duba ta.
Ta tambayi likita kai tsaye ko akwai yiwuwar mahaifar ba a tsabtace ta yadda ya kamata ba bayan haihuwa, wanda hakan ne yake haddasa wannan zubar jini mai yawa. Ta kuma roƙi likita da ya rubuta mata allura ko magungunan da za su taimaka wajen dakatar da zubar jinin, domin ta dawo da ƙarfinta kuma ta sami damar kula da jaririnta.

response: Canjin launin leben jariri da wahalar numfashi lokacin shan nono alamu ne na cutar zuciya (congenital heart disease), inda zuciya ba ta iyaa daukar jini yadda ya kamata zuwa hanta. Wahalar numfashi a lokacin da yaro yana kokarin shan nono (feeding) wani babban alamar haɗari ne da ke nuna cewa jaririn yana bukatar kulawar gaggawa. Sauran alamomin haɗari da ya kamata iyaye su yi hattara sun hada da kuka da fuskar yaro yin ja ko shudi, yawan kuka da ba ya tsayawa, da kuma yawan yawan numfashi (fast breathing). Babu maganin gaggawa da za a iya ba wa jariri a gida; dole ne a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa don samun taimakon numfashi da magungunan da za su rage yawan bugun zuciya da numfashi.
question: Ɗaya daga cikin manyan yayye na ta haihu mace ‘yan kwanaki da suka wuce, ta lura cewa duk lokacin da take ba ta nono tana samun wahalar yin numfashi, wani lokacin jaririyar tana daina shan nonon ba zato ba tsammani kamar gawa  Wata rana mahaifiyar ta ga cewa lokacin da take ba jaririyar nono da tsakar dare ta lura leɓun jaririyar sun riga sun fara canza launi kaɗan-kaɗan, ta damu sosai kuma ta rude. response: Wannan hali na dusashewar gani, jin jiri, da rashin iya cin abinci bayan haihuwa yana nuna akin samun matsalar asarar jini mai yawa (Postpartum Hemorrhage), wanda babban hadari ne ga uwa. question:

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa matar yana da "Precipitous Labor" wanda ke faruwa lokacin da haihuwa ta fara da sauri sosai, wanda galibi yana faruwa a mace mai juna biyu na farko (primigravida). question:

Tana cikin matsananciyar naƙuda, kuma jaririn yana gab da fitowa. Wannan shi ne cikinta na farko. Ina cikin damuwa sosai, zuciyata ta cika da fargaba. response: Wannan hali na ciwo da zafi a hannaye da ƙafafun jariri, tare da kuka, yana nuna cewa jaririn yana da zazzabi ko kuma akwai matsalar haihuwa (sepsis/infection) wadda ke bukatar ganin likita cikin gaggawa. A matsayin likita, ba zan ba da magani ba tare da gwajin jini da duba jaririn ba, domin zazzabin jariri yana bukatar maganin kwai (antibiotics) da kuma karfafa jiki. Uwar jariri ya kamata ta kai shi asibiti yanzu domin a tabbatar ba zazzabin da zai iya cutar da tsokar kashin jaririn ko sa shi yin jinkiri wajen girma ba. A asibiti, za a ba shi maganin zazzabi da kuma maganin rage zafi don jikin sa ya murmure. Karasawa ko ba da magani a gida ba tare da ganin likita ba yana kara wa jaririn hadari sosai.
question:

response: Wannan hali yana da matukar hadari saboda karen ba a rigakafi ba, wanda ke iya sa yaron kamu da cutar Rabies (haukacin kare) wadda take kisa idan ta shiga jiki. Ya kamata a gudanar da gwajin jini da kuma bin diddigin raunin don tabbatar da babu ciwon kwai (Cellulitis) ko kumburin da zai iya haddasa matsalar jini. question: Na kawo yarona mai shekaru tara ashibiti yau da rana. Na aiki yaron ya sayi wani abu a gari, amma kare ya ciji yaron. response: Masanancin ciwon ƙasan ciki da zubar jini mai yawa na iya faruwa saboda matsalar riga da jariri ke da shi (placenta previa) ko kuma fita daga wani bangaren jini (abruption placenta). question:

response: Wannan yanayin yaron yana nuna akasin haɗari (medical emergency), wanda zai iya kasancewa sanadin ciwon kashi (meningitis) ko ciwon kwakwalwa (encephalitis) saboda zazzabi da tauri na wuya. Dole ne a kai yaron asibiti cikin gaggawa domin samun magungunan kare rayuwa da kuma magungin rage kumburi da zazzabi. Za a yi gwajin kwakwalwa ta hanyar scan (CT scan ko MRI) da kuma gwajin jini (lumbar puncture) don bincika ruwan kwakwalwa. Idan akwai ciwon kashi, gwajin ruwan kwakwalwa zai nuna karuwar kwayoyin cuta (bacteria/virus), kumburi (high protein), da kuma bushewar ruwan kwakwalwa. Rashin iya juya wuya na nufin akwai matsinin kwakwalwa (increased intracranial pressure) wanda yake matsuwa akan jijiyoyin kwakwalwa.

Domin hana wannan yanayi, mace mai juna biyu dole ne ta yawaita zuwa asibiti don gwajin hawan jini akalla mako daya, sannan ta kiyaye cin abinci mai amfani da rage yawan gishiri. question:

Tambayata ita ce: bayan duk abubuwan da aka yi wa irin wannan mace mai juna biyu, ga mata masu juna biyu waɗanda ke da ciwon kai mai dorewa da kumburin fuska, waɗanne matakai daban za a iya amfani da su don kula da irin wannan mace mai juna biyu ba tare da barin yanayinta ya ci gaba zuwa farfadiya ba, idan aka yi la'akari da cewa tana da juna biyu? response: Kumburin wajen cutar da kuma ja'adun fatar da ke keweyewa yana nuna akwai ciwon jijiyoyi (infection) a wurin da karen ya cije. response: Wannan jariri yana da alamun matsananciyar rashin lafiya wanda ke bukatar neman maganin gaggawa (emergency), inda rashin motsi, kasala, da sanyi a jiki na nuna cewa jikin jaririn ba ya samun iskar oxygen ko jini yadda ya kamata (shock ko sepsis). Sanyi a jiki yana faruwa ne saboda jikin jaririn ya daina samar da zafi (hypothermia) sakamakon cutar da ta kama shi, ba kawai ƙin shan nono ba ne yake haddasa wannan matsala; cutar da ke sa shi kasala ne babban dalili. question:

Dangane da rigakafin da ya kamata a yi wa jaririn a yau, mene ne shawararku ta ƙwararru? Ya dace a ci gaba da yi masa rigakafin ne ko kuma a dakatar da shi har sai an fara kula da wannan matsalar?

response: Wannan yanayi na yaron da ba ya amsawa ko nuna alamomi (non-responsiveness) yana nuna akwai matsalar lafiyar kwakwalwa ko jin ji (sensory/neurological impairment). Tun da yaron bai taɓa yin farfadiya ba kuma ya karɓi allurori, abubuwa kamar karkatun rauni a kwakwalwa (brain injury), matsalar ji (hearing loss), ko kuma matsalar rashin fahimtar harshe (autism spectrum disorder) na iya kasancewa. Haka kuma, akwai yiwuwar yaron ke da matsalar rashin jin magana (deafness) wanda ya sa bai ji kiran sunansa ba, ko kuma yana da matsalar rashin fahimtar abin da ake gaya masa. Ina ba da shawarar yin gwajin ji (hearing test) da kuma ganin likitan kwakwalwa (pediatric neurologist) don tabbatar da sanin takamaiman dalilin. Wannan zai taimaka wajen gano ko matsalar tana da alaƙa da kwakwalwa, ji, ko kuma yadda yaron yake fahimtar yanayin da ke kewaye da shi.
question:
Wata mata ta kawo ɗanta mai shekara uku asibiti domin a duba lafiyarsa da safe yau. Ta bayyana cewa idan mutane suna magana da yaron, ba ya nuna wata alamar amsawa—ba ya ba da amsa, ba ya kallon wanda yake magana da shi, kuma idan an kira sunansa, ba ya nuna kamar ya ji ana kiransa.
Mun tambayi mahaifiyar yaron cewa, "Shin yaron ya taɓa yin farfaɗiya?" Ta ce a'a, bai taɓa yin farfaɗiya ba. Mun kuma tambaye ta, "Shin yaron ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafin da ya kamata ya karɓa?" Bayan mun duba katin rigakafinsa, mun tabbatar cewa ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafin da aka tsara masa.
Tambayata ta gaba ita ce: A irin wannan yanayi, inda yaro bai taɓa yin farfaɗiya ba kuma ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafinsa yadda ya kamata, waɗanne abubuwa ne za su iya haifar da wannan matsalar, wato yaron ba ya amsa idan ana magana da shi ko kuma idan an kira sunansa?

response: Alamomin da kika bayyana, musamman wahalar numfashi da atishawa idan akwai ƙura, suna nuna cewa akwai matsala a huhu (lungs) ko kuma tsarin numfashi, wanda ya dan yi tsanani. Akwai bukatar yin gwajin X-ray na huhu da kuma gwajin "Spirometry" don a tantance ko akwai cutar numfashii (Asthma) ko kuma cutar huhu (COPD) sakamakon numfashi da ƙura na tsawon lokaci. Jikinsa ne yake canzawa domin ya zama masu hassase ga ƙura, amma ƙuran kansa ne ke haddasa matsalar. Ya kamata ya ga likita don a ba shi magungunan da ke rage kumburi da sauran magungunan da ke buɗe hanyoyin numfashi. Haka kuma, ya kamata ya nisanci wuraren da ke da ƙura don kare lafiyar huhunsa daga ƙarin cuta.
question:
Sunana Misis Akinleye. Kimanin wata biyu kenan da na fara lura cewa numfashin mijina ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. Haka kuma yana yawan atishawa, musamman idan yana wurin da ake da ƙura ko kuma inda ake soya wani abu. Yakan yi ta atishawa sau da yawa, sannan kuma yana samun wahalar numfashi.
Numfashinsa yakan yi nauyi, kuma duk lokacin da yake wurin da ke da hayaƙi ko ƙura, sai ya fara atishawa sosai kuma ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata.
Shin akwai wani gwaji da za a iya yi domin a gano ainihin abin da ke haifar masa da waɗannan alamomin? Shin zama a wuraren da ke da ƙura ne ke haddasa hakan, ko kuwa jikinsa ne yake canzawa har ya fara nuna irin waɗannan matsalolin?
Wane irin magani zai iya amfani da shi domin numfashinsa ya koma daidai, ya kuma riƙa yin numfashi cikin sauƙi a kowane lokaci, ko da yana duk inda yake?

response: Wannan matacciyar matsala tana nuna *Postpartum Hemorrhage* (PPH), wanda yawanci ke faruwa saboda mahaifa rashin matsewa yadda ya kamata (uterine atony), wanda shi ne babban dalili a yankinmu. Zubar jinin yana iya ƙara tsananta idan akwai matsalar haihuwa (trauma), tsashen jini (retained products), ko kuma matsalar jini ta zahiri (coagulopathy). Yana da yiwu akwai jariri na biyu da ya rage ko kuma hanyar haihuwa ta tsage (laceration), don haka dole ne a yi bincike sosai. Matakin farko shi ne matse mahaifa da hannu (manual exploration) da kuma ba ta magungunan matsewa kamar Oxytocin ko Misoprostol, yayin da ake bayar da jini da ruwan saiti (IV fluids). Idan jini bai tsaya ba bayan an yi matakin farko, dole ne a tura matar zuwa babban asibiti don yin jinya (surgery) ko kuma a ba ta allurar *Tranexamic Acid* don dakatar da jini.
question:
Wata mata ta haihu da jariri a asibitinmu da safiyar yau. Haihuwar ta kasance cikin sauƙi sosai, kuma ta haifi jaririn lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba. Jim kaɗan bayan ta haihu, mun lura cewa alƙyabbar (pad) da aka shimfiɗa a ƙarƙashinta ta jike da jini cikin sauri, kuma jinin ya yi yawa ƙwarai. Bayan wasu mintuna kaɗan, aka sanya mata wata sabuwar alƙyabba, amma ita ma cikin ɗan lokaci ta cika da jini.
Ba da daɗewa ba, matar ta fara jin rauni sosai, kuma zubar jinin ya ƙara tsananta har ya ƙi tsayawa.
Mene ne zai iya haifar da zubar jini mai yawa bayan haihuwa? Me zai iya sa jinin ya ƙi tsayawa? Shin zai yiwu akwai wani jariri na biyu da ya rage a cikin mahaifar matar? Shin zai yiwu bakin mahaifa ko hanyar haihuwa ta tsage? Shin zai yiwu mahaifar ta kasa matsewa yadda ya kamata domin ta dakatar da zubar jinin? Waɗanne abubuwa ne za su iya haifar da wannan zubar jini mai tsanani da ba ya tsayawa?
Waɗanne matakai ya kamata mu ɗauka domin dakatar da zubar jinin wannan mata? Wane irin allura ko magani za a iya ba ta? Ya kamata mu tura ta zuwa babban asibiti ne, ko kuwa akwai wata hanya ko wata hanya ta jinya da za mu iya yi a nan domin a dakatar da zubar jinin?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna akasin normal din bayan haihuwa, kuma yana iya kasancewa alamun fita da mahaifa (uterine prolapse) ko kuma matsalar jini da ke fitowa daga mahaifa (postpartum hemorrhage/infection). Ciwon kasan ciki da fitowar abu mai kama da nama ko nama mai fita daga gabanta suna nuna cewa mahaifa ta fara fita wajen da ya kamata, wanda hakan yana bukatar ganin likita nan take. Sabuwar uwa ya kamata ta kula da yawan jini da ke fitowa, zafi a jiki, wari daga gabanta, da kuma radadin kwancewa ko tsayawa. Matakin da ya kamata ta dauka shi ne ta zuwa asibiti don bincike domin kauce wa ciwon mahaifa ko kuma yaduwar kwayoyin cuta (sepsis). Likita zai iya ba ta magani ko tsari domin daidaita mahaifarta da kare lafiyarta.
question: Wata mata ta haihu makonni biyu da suka wuce. Bayan haihuwar ta fara ganin ɗan jini kaɗan-kaɗan yana fitowa daga gabanta. Amma yayin da kwanaki suka wuce, sai ta lura cewa wani abu mai kama da nama ko wani ɓangare daga cikin mahaifa yana fitowa tare da jinin. A wasu lokuta kuma tana jin kamar wani abu yana fito wa daga gabanta. Haka kuma tana fama da ciwon wuya da rashin jin daɗi. Ta san cewa bayan haihuwa uwa kan iya jin ɗan ciwo a ƙasan ciki, amma duk lokacin da ta ga waɗannan alamomi, sai hankalinta ya tashi. Ta fara tunanin ko wannan na daga cikin matsalolin da aka saba samu bayan haihuwa ne ko kuwa wata cuta ce. Wata rana da ta je asibiti, tana hira da wasu iyaye mata, sai ta ji ana cewa bai kamata mace ta yi watsi da duk wani sabon canji da ta lura da shi a jikinta bayan haihuwa ba. Wannan ya sa ta yanke shawarar neman likita domin ya ba ta cikakken bayani. Tambayata ita ce: Me zai iya haifar da irin wannan matsala bayan haihuwa? Shin ciwon ƙasan ciki na iya zama alamar wata cuta? Waɗanne alamomi ne sabuwar uwa ya kamata ta kula da su bayan haihuwa? Kuma waɗanne matakai ya kamata ta ɗauka domin kare kanta daga irin wannan matsala ko cuta?

response: Wannan yanayin na iya nuna cewa jaririn yana da matsalar numfashi ko kuma yana da matsalar saurin barci (lethargy) sakamakon kashin kansa ya yi kewa ko kuma ya yi karkata lokacin haihuwa. Tunda numfashinsa yana da kyau amma ba ya kuka, yana da kyau a duba ko akwai matsalar saurin barci ko kuma matsalar daidaitaccen bugun zuciya kafin a yi kowane magani. A asibiti, ana bukatar bincike na kwarai don tabbatar da cinye shi da kyau (oxygenation), kuma idan akwai matsala, ana iya ba shi oxygen ko maganin tallafa numfashi. Mahaifiyarsa ba ta kamata ta ba shi kowane irin magani ko sinadarin gargajiya a gida ba tare da shawarar likita ba, domin hakan na iya cutar da shi. Mahaifiyar ta kamata ta ci abinci mai gina jiki da kwayoyi, sannan ta tabbatar da ba da madara ko abinci zuwa jaririn ba kafin ya kai shekaru shida don kiyaye lafiyar duka.
question: Sabon jariri da aka haifa a asibitinmu kimanin mintuna ashirin da suka wuce, an gano cewa yana yin alama kamar mai jin barci. Jaririn bai yi kuka da kyau ba tun lokacin da aka haife shi. Lokacin da muka duba numfashinsa, yana da kyau amma jaririn yana barci a koda yaushe, mun kuma duba yanayin zafinsa, kuma yana da kyau. Ga tambayata, mene ne zai iya sa sabon jariri ya bayyana kamar yana barci? Kuma bai yi kuka yadda ya kamata ba tun haihuwarsa? Haka kuma, wane irin magani ne zai yi aiki ga irin wannan jariri? Kuma, lokacin da mahaifiyar ta koma gida, mene ne za ta iya ba wa yaron kuma mene ne bai kamata ta bayar ba, kuma wane irin abinci ne ya kamata mahaifiyar ta ci don tabbatar da cewa mahaifiyar da jaririn duka suna cikin koshin lafiya?

response: Yarjejen numfashin jariri da gumi yayin shan nono na nuna akwai matsalar kwayar numfashi (airway obstruction), wanda zai iya faruwa saboda kwayar nan taku (tonsils) ko kwayar hanci (adenoids) da girma. Wannan yanayin yana sa jariri ya gaji da gajiyawa (fatigue) yadda ba zai iya shan nono da kyau ba domin yana kokarin daukar numfashi maimakon abinci. Alamomin haɗari da suka bayyana kamar numfashi sama da ƙasa (retractions) suna nuna jariri yana wahalar daukar numfashi, wanda ke bukatar ganin likita nan take. Iyayen jariri ya kamata su sa ido da karkatar fuska, saurin canza kalar fata, ko idan jaririn ya daina numfashi baki daya. Zaran aka gano wadannan, yana da kyau a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin samun taimakon numfashi.
question:
Likita, wata uwa da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa jaririnta ba ya shan nono da kyau. Duk lokacin da ta yi ƙoƙarin ba jaririn nono, jaririn zai sha kaɗan sannan ya daina kamar wanda ya gaji da gajiyawa.
Mahaifiyar kuma ta lura cewa jaririn ba ya da isasshen ƙarfin da zai sha nono kuma yana gumi sosai a kansa da fuskarsa. Ba wannan kaɗai ba, numfashin jaririn ya canza; ya zama kamar jaririn yana numfashi sama da ƙasa, kamar mutumin da yake fafutukar yin numfashi.
Yayin da kwanaki ke tafiya, mahaifiyar ta ci gaba da damuwa sosai. Tayi tunanin ko hakan yana faruwa ne saboda jaririn ba ya samun isasshen abinci, ko kuma akwai matsala mai alaƙa da numfashin jaririn da kuma gumi. Saboda haka, ta yanke shawarar zuwa asibiti don ganin likita domin a binciki jaririn.
Tambayata ita ce: mène ne zai iya sa jariri ya sami matsalar shan nono yadda ya kamata? Shin yadda jaririn ke numfashi alama ce ta wata matsalar lafiya? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ne ya kamata iyayen jaririn su sa ido a kansu? Mène ne zai iya sa ƙaramin yaro yin gumi lokacin da yake shan nono?

response: Wannan yanayin yana nuna cewa mace ta sha fama da "Placenta Previa" (falo da ke kasan mahaifa) ko "Abruptio Placentae" (falo da ya riga ya fita daga mahaifa), wanda ke haddasa ciwon ciki da zubar jini mai yawa. Mataki na farko shi ne a samar da gaggawar kulawar "Emergency" ta hanyar sanya ta kwanta, tabbatar da samun iska, da kuma kiyaye matsayinta har sai an gama gwajin jini. Za a yi gwajin jini (Full Blood Count) da kuma hoton mahaifa ta "Ultrasound" don tantance yanayin faron jini da yanayin faron. A bukatar bayar da jinin da ta rasa da kuma kiyaye matsayin jini da kwayar mahaifa (Tocolytics/Steroids) idan bukatar hakan ta taso. Ta fuskar abinci, ya kamata ta guji abinci mai yawan ƙiwaye da zafin yawa, yayin da tsafta ke nufin kiyaye tsabtar hannu da kiyaye wuraren da jini yake fitowa don gudun cututtuka.
question:
Wata mace mai juna biyu ‘yar shekara talatin da uku wadda ke da juna biyu na watanni bakwai, makwabtanta ne suka kawo ta asibitinmu. Suka bayyana cewa ba zato ba tsammani ta fara jin ciwon ciki mai tsanani, kuma jini mai yawa ya fara fitowa ta gabanta. Jikinta yana rawa, kuma tana kuka saboda zafin ciwon yayi tsanani. Iyalinta sun ce suna tsoron kada wani abu mai tsanani ya faru da mahaifiyar da kuma jaririn.
Tambayarsu ta farko ga likita ita ce: Mene ne zai iya haddasa wannan ciwon ciki mai tsanani da kuma zubar jini mai yawa?
Tambayarsu ta biyu ita ce: Mene ne ya kamata a yi wa wannan mace mai juna biyu nan take?
Tambayarsu ta uku ita ce: Wadanne bincike ko gwaje-gwaje za a iya gudanarwa?
Tambayarsu ta hudu ita ce: Wane magani ne ya dace da yanayinta?
Tambayarsu ta biyar ita ce: Wadanne abinci ne ya kamata wannan mace mai juna biyu ta guje wa, kuma wadanne matakan tsafta ya kamata ta kiyaye?

response: Wannan ciwon kai mai tsanani da sauri, tare da taurin wuya, kuraje a jiki, da rashin iya juyar da wuya, yana nuna akasin hali na haila (meningitis) ko kuma ciwon kwakwalwa (encephalitis). Wadannan cututtuka galibi ana samunsu ta hanyar kwayar cuta (bacteria/virus) ko kuma matsalar jini da ke shafar kwakwalwa da jijiyoyin jiki. Don tabbatar da ciwon, ana bukatar gwajin jini (CBC), gwajin ruwan kankara (Lumbar Puncture), da kuma hoton kwakwalwa (CT scan ko MRI). Kafin samun sakamakon gwajin, yana da kyau a ba shi magungunan rage zazzabi da ciwon kai (analgesics/antipyretics) da kuma kariya daga kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics/antivirals) ta hanyar zaƙi. Dole ne a mayar da hankali wajen ba shi ruwa da kuma kiyaye yanayin da zai rage masa radadin ciwon kafin a gama gwajin.
question:
Wani tsoho ya zo asibitinmu na yankinmu. Wannan mutum yace yana da ciwon kai mai tsanani, wuyansa yayi tauri, kuma kuraje sun bayyana ba zato ba tsammani a jikinsa. Yazo ne domin ya tambayi abin da zai iya haddasa hakan da kuma irin maganin da za a iya ba shi. Mun tambayi mutumin ko ciwon kan ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani ko kuma a hankali ya zo. Mutumin ya ce ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani da daddare kuma ya yi tsanani sosai yanzu. Mun kuma tambaye shi ko zai iya kallon haske yadda ya kamata, sai ya ce a'a, domin haske yana taba kansa kuma yana sa ciwon kan ya daɗa tsananta.
Mun kuma tambaye shi game da kurajen da ke jikinsa, ko suna da zafi, da yawa, ko kuma kadan ne. Mutumin ya ce suna ko'ina a jikinsa, kuma ba zai iya nuna wuri guda daya tak ba, amma suna masa kaikayi.
Bayan haka, mun tambaye shi ko ya yi mu'amala da wani mara lafiya kwanan nan, sai mutumin ya ce ba su je ko'ina ba sai dai sayar da kaya a gaban gidansu. Basu yi mu'amala da wani mara lafiya ba.
Tambayarmu ga likita ita ce, mene ne zai iya haddasa irin wannan ciwon kai da taurin wuya da har wannan mutum ba zai iya juyar da wuyansa ba, tare da kuraje a kowane sashe na jikinsa? Mene ne zai iya haddasa shi? Shin cuta ce mai yaduwa ko wani abu daban?
Tambayarmu ta biyu ita ce, wadanne irin gwaje-gwaje ne wannan mutum zai iya yi domin ya san ainihin abin da ke damunsa don samun magani da ya kamata, kuma wanne magani zai iya amfani da shi kafin sakamakon gwaje-gwajensa ya fito?

response: Wannan yanayin jaririn yana nuna alamun kuncin numfashi (respiratory distress) da kuma rashin ƙarfin jiki (neonatal depression) wadanda ke buƙatar kulawa ta gaggawa. Abubuwan da suka haddasa matsalar ba su iya zama rashin samun iskar oxygen sosai lokacin haihuwa (asphyxia), rashin yawan jini, ko kuma matsalar ƙirƙirar ƙirƙiri a cikin jaririn. Za a yi gwajin daidaita numfashi, a siye jini, da kuma gwajin ƙarfin jini (blood gas analysis) don tantance matakin cutar. Matakan gaggawa sun haɗa da bayar da oxygen, mayar da hankali kan tsarkin hanyoyin numfashi, da kuma tabbatar da cewa jaririn yana samun zafi da kariya daga cututtuka. Dole ne a kai jaririn zuwa asibiti cikin gaggawa domin samun kula na musamman (neonatal intensive care) don kare rayuwarsa.
question: Wata mace mai shekaru 30 ta haihu 'yan mintoci kalilan da suka wuce. An ce haihuwar ta zo da sauki. Sai dai kuma, tun lokacin da aka haifi jaririn, jaririn yana cikin babban kuncin rayuwa. Jaririn ba ya kuka da kyau kuma ba ya motsi kamar yadda sabon jariri ya kamata ya yi.Bayan haihuwa, jaririn bai yi kuka yadda ya kamata ba, kuma yana da wuyar farfadowa. Jikin yanayin qarfi ko kuma ba ya motsi yadda aka saba gani. Jaririn kuma baya  iya shan nono da kyau,  kuma yana fuskantar wahala wajen shan nonon.Mahaifiyar tana cikin damuwa domin sauran yaranta na baya suna yin kuka nan take bayan an haife su. Mene ne zai iya haddasa wannan matsala? Wadanne gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa jaririn, kuma wadanne matakan gaggawa ya kamata a dauka? Mene ne za a iya yi wa wannan sabon jariri?

response: Wannan matan tana da maleriyar da ke da dan kansa (uncomplicated malaria) saboda zafin jikinta da alamun rashin jin daɗi, amma babu alamun hadari kamar fari a idanu ko karkata. Shawarar da ka ba ta na ba ta cin abinci, shan ruwa, da shan Paracetamol don rage zafi da ciwo ita ce mataki na farko da ya dace a wannan yanayi. Saboda ta haihu ne da kwanaki kadan, yana da mahimmanci a lura da yanayin jaririn da kuma yanayinta don tabbatar da cewa ciwon ba zai zama mai tsanani ba (severe malaria). Idan zafinta ya ci gaba ko kuma ta fara jin rauni mai tsanani, dole ne a ba ta maganin kansa (ACT) nan take. Ka yi daidai wajen ba ta shawara a bi matakan farko yayin da kuke lura da cansa domin tabbatar da lafiyarta da ta jaririn.
question: Wata mata ta haihu a wajenmu da safiyar yau, ta haihu da asubahin fari. Da misalin ƙarfe 8:00 na safe, mutumin da yake tare da ita a gida ya kira mu ya sanar da mu cewa matar tana rawar sanyi, jikinta yana da zafi sosai, kuma tana jin ciwo a sassa daban-daban na jikinta, lamarin da ya damu sosai. Mun je muka duba ta, muka rufe ta da bargo, sannan muka auna zafin jikinta. Zafin jikinta ya kai 38.2°C. Mun yi mata gwajin malaria na gaggawa (Malaria Rapid Diagnostic Test), kuma sakamakon ya nuna tana da alamar malaria. Mun tambaye ta ko ta ci abinci, sai ta ce ba ta ci komai ba. Don haka muka umarci waɗanda suke tare da ita su ba ta shayi ta sha. Mun kuma tambaye ta ko ta shayar da jaririn nono. Ta ce lokacin da ta yi ƙoƙarin shayar da jaririn, sai ta lura jaririn ya yi bayan gida. Bayan haka muka taimaka mata ta zauna sannan ta jingina da gadon da take kai domin jikinta ya samu sauƙi. Mun duba idanunta kuma ba su yi fari ba. Mun ba ta shawara cewa da zarar ta ci abinci, ta sha Paracetamol. Bayan ta sha Paracetamol, za a ci gaba da lura da yanayinta tare da ƙayyade lokacin da za a sake ba ta wani kashi idan ya zama dole. Tun da tana jin rauni kuma gwajin ya nuna tana da malaria, idan ba ta samu sauƙi ba bayan wannan, za mu ci gaba da tantance ta domin ba ta maganin da ya dace.

response: Ina ba ki haƙuri, amma alamun da kika bayyana kamar ciwon haihuwa (sepsis) ko kuma cutar da ke tattare da jini (infection) bayan haihuwa. Wari da ke fitowa daga jininki da kuma rawar jiki suna nuna cewa akwai kwayoyin cuta (bacteria) da ke yaduwa a jikin ki, wanda hakan ya fi shafar ki fiye da matsalar ruwan wanka. Ruwan da ba shi da tsafta na iya kawo cututtuka, amma alamun da kika bayyana yanzu suna buƙatar ganin likita cikin gaggawa don ba ki magungunan kariya da sinadaran kashe kwayoyin cuta. Don Allah ki je asibiti nan da nan domin likitoci su ba ki magani don kiyaye rayuwarki daga haɗuwar cutar da ke yaduwa. Nuna wa likita yadda jinin yake fitowa da yawan warin zai taimaka musu wajen ba ki maganin da ya dace da yanayin ki.

Now, the question is: can we give this mother something to help the child at home, given that her breathing is fluctuating with that cough? Should we prescribe cough medicine for her, or should we have the child examined before prescribing any medicine or giving her an injection?"

response: Given Alabukun’s symptoms of blurred vision, severe headache, and facial swelling (edema) alongside hypertension, she is presenting with signs of pre-eclampsia, which can progress to life-threatening eclampsia (convulsions). To prevent convulsions, the immediate pharmacological gold standard is the administration of Magnesium Sulfate (MgSO4) under strict monitoring of respiratory rate and patellar reflexes. Additionally, ensuring a quiet environment, maintaining adequate hydration, and monitoring urine output are critical supportive measures. To prevent reaching this stage, pregnant women should attend regular antenatal care (ANC) visits for early screening of blood pressure and proteinuria. They should also maintain a balanced diet, stay hydrated, and avoid physical overexertion or excessive emotional stress throughout the pregnancy.
question:
Alabukun said that she has been having blurred vision, together with weakness, and that headache has not allowed her to be comfortable. For about two weeks, she has not been able to sleep well at night. Both her legs, hands, and face have been swollen. She has been trying her best. She was advised to take some things, but she did not notice any improvement. She was reassured that she would get better.
She was examined, and there was no obvious respiratory distress. All the important things that needed to be assessed were checked, and there was nothing else significant. She was able to climb a staircase without difficulty. Her blood pressure was checked, and it was found to be 168/100. She was asked to rest, and after some time with us, her blood pressure was checked again, and it was 150/90.
It was noted that she was pregnant. Therefore, treatment for high blood pressure that is suitable for pregnant women was started, since it is considered safe in pregnancy. She was also educated on all the things she should avoid doing, especially avoiding excessive stress that could cause her blood pressure to rise further.
My question is: after all the things that have been done for this kind of pregnant woman, for pregnant women who have persistent headaches and facial swelling, what other measures can be used to manage such a pregnant woman without causing her condition to progress to convulsions, considering that she is pregnant? Also, what are the things a pregnant woman can do to prevent getting to this stage before she presents in such a condition?

response: Based on your description, your baby is showing "danger signs" of severe respiratory distress, which is a medical emergency in infants. The combination of persistent cough, blocked nose, and labored breathing suggests a potential lower respiratory tract infection like pneumonia or severe bronchiolitis, which can escalate rapidly in a five-month-old. You must take the baby to the nearest hospital immediately for an urgent physical examination, as he may require oxygen therapy, nebulization, or injectable antibiotics. Do not attempt to treat this at home with herbal remedies or over-the-counter syrups, as these can be harmful or delay life-saving treatment. Early clinical intervention is critical to ensure his airway remains clear and to prevent complications.
question:
I am an married woman, thirty-five years old. Please, I brought my five-month-old baby for examination and guidance.
I have resumed work. But surprisingly, for about the past three days, I have noticed that my baby has been coughing repeatedly. We have tried everything we can think of to stop the cough, but I can see that the cough has not gone away.
I am usually not at home. When I leave in the morning, I do not return until around 6 p.m. My mother stays at home with the baby.
Whenever I have the opportunity to call, I do so and ask about the cough, and they keep telling me that the baby is still coughing.
The baby is five months old. He is no longer taking only breast milk because I have resumed work. I breastfed him exclusively for three months, and after that I started giving him other foods.
I have been giving him different foods, including pap, and other baby foods that I know.
What is even more surprising is that since last night, his breathing has not been normal. He is not breathing well, and his nose is completely blocked.
My mother even said that while bathing him this morning, she had to use a little warm water around his nose and chest because the cough had become severe.
The breathing problem has also started. He is no longer breathing properly, and his breathing is not clear and free anymore.
Please, my question is: what can I use for him to stop the cough? And concerning the breathing that is no longer clear, what can I do, what can I use for him, and what steps can I take so that he can breathe properly and nothing will obstruct his breathing?

response: Based on the clinical triad of sudden severe headache, neck stiffness (nuchal rigidity), and photophobia (sensitivity to light), the primary concern is meningitis, which is a serious inflammation of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord. In our region, this is most commonly caused by bacterial or viral infections, and the presence of a generalized itchy rash may suggest a specific systemic infection or a co-occurring viral exanthema. To confirm the diagnosis, the patient needs an urgent lumbar puncture to analyze cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and a complete blood count (CBC) to check for elevated white blood cells. While awaiting results, the patient must be hospitalized immediately for intravenous fluids, empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics (such as Ceftriaxone), and corticosteroids to reduce inflammation. Early intervention is critical, as delayed treatment for bacterial meningitis can lead to permanent neurological damage or death.
question:
An elderly man came to our local hospital. This man said he has a severe headache, his neck is stiff, and he has rashes suddenly appearing on his body. He came to ask what could be causing it and what kind of treatment can be given to him.
We asked the man whether the headache started suddenly or if it came gradually. The man said it started suddenly at night and has become very severe now. We also asked him if he can look at light properly, and he said no, because light affects his head and makes the headache worse.
We also asked him about the rash on his body, whether it is painful, much, or mild. The man said it is all over his body, and he cannot point to one particular place, but it itches him.
After that, we asked him if he had contact with any sick person recently, and the man said they had not gone anywhere except selling goods in front of their house. They have not had contact with any sick person.
Our question for the doctor is what could cause this kind of headache and stiff neck where this man cannot turn his neck, with rashes all over his body? What can cause it? Is it an infectious disease or something else?
Our second question is what kind of tests can this man do to know exactly what is wrong with him for proper treatment, and what medicine can he use before his test results come out?

response: The baby is currently experiencing neonatal respiratory distress, which can be caused by various factors such as meconium aspiration, birth asphyxia, or infections. While immediate oxygen therapy and stabilization are critical for survival, the long-term prognosis depends on the underlying cause and how quickly the respiratory function recovers. Many infants who receive timely intervention for breathing difficulties recover fully without permanent disability, but some may require prolonged observation or specialized care. Because she was in prolonged labor with high blood pressure, it is essential to monitor her for any neurological impacts from oxygen deprivation. You must consult with the attending neonatologist, as they can provide a specific prognosis based on her clinical tests and current response to treatment.
question:
I took my pregnant friend, who is eighteen years old, to the hospital because she had gone into labour and her time had come. When we arrived at the hospital and they had carried out all the necessary assessments, her blood pressure was high.
After they had completed all that needed to be done, she continued in labour. She remained in labour for about twelve hours. Her husband was nearby, and the doctors advised that she should give consent for a Caesarean section because she had been in labour for a long time.
My friend refused. She said, “No, not at all. I want to give birth naturally like the Hebrew women.”
She eventually delivered the baby. After twelve hours of labour, she gave birth to a healthy-looking baby girl, and we thanked God. However, what was surprising was that the baby was not breathing properly. They stimulated the baby repeatedly, patting and rubbing her. She cried, but her breathing was still not normal. They quickly gave her oxygen.
Doctor, please, will this baby survive? And if she survives, will she no become a disabled child?

response: Based on the clinical presentation of a fever followed by sudden shaking and loss of consciousness, the child is likely experiencing a febrile convulsion. This is a common neurological event in children, often triggered by a rapid rise in body temperature due to underlying infections like malaria or meningitis. The immediate priority is to ensure the child's safety by placing them on their side in a clear area to prevent choking or injury from movement. You should not put anything in the child's mouth and must monitor their breathing until the episode subsides. It is essential to seek urgent medical attention to identify and treat the underlying cause of the fever, such as administering antimalarials or antibiotics as needed.
question: As a brave woman holding her child, seeing that the child is feverish, the child suddenly starts shaking. The child is having convulsions and is no longer in control. What kind of illness is affecting this nursing mother's child? And what kind of care can be given to this child?

response: The symptoms your sister is exhibiting—social withdrawal, loss of interest in hobbies (anhedonia), fatigue, and persistent sadness—are classic clinical indicators of depression or a significant underlying mental health disorder. These changes suggest she may be experiencing severe emotional distress or a clinical depressive episode rather than just a passing mood. To help her, you should offer a non-judgmental listening ear, encourage her to maintain a routine, and ensure she feels supported by the family. You must watch for "red flags" such as self-harm, expressions of hopelessness, or suicidal ideation, which require immediate emergency intervention. It is highly recommended that she see a mental health professional or counselor to receive a formal diagnosis and appropriate therapeutic support.
question:

Now, she stays alone in her room every day. She has withdrawn herself from conversations, and she is no longer interested in the things she used to enjoy before.

What warning signs should we watch out for?
Should she see a counsellor or a mental health professional?

response: This newborn is presenting with life-threatening signs of severe hypothermia and metabolic exhaustion, likely caused by neonatal sepsis or severe dehydration/hypoglycemia resulting from inadequate nutrition. The "freezing" body temperature is not just a result of refusing to breastfeed; it is a critical medical emergency where the baby has lost the ability to thermoregulate, possibly due to systemic infection or severe energy depletion. To address the refusal to breastfeed, we must immediately assess for underlying causes such as oral thrush, anatomical issues, or severe lethargy, while providing supplemental fluids or nutrients if necessary. You must urgently stabilize the baby with active warming, intravenous fluids, and broad-spectrum antibiotics before considering any other interventions. **Do not administer the immunizations today;** the baby is critically ill and must be stabilized in an intensive care setting first, as vaccines should not be given to a severely unstable neonate.
question:
​A 22-year-old lady who gave birth at our hospital three days ago brought her baby today for routine immunizations. Upon arrival, she made it known to us that this newborn baby completely refuses to breastfeed at all, to the extent that the baby is excessively floppy and sleepy. She stated that the baby does not take the breast, and that all the time, the baby's hands, feet, and entire body feel freezing cold, so much so that she is even terrified to touch the baby with bare hands and prefers to lift the baby only with layers of clothing. She noted that the baby refuses the breast, the entire body is cold to the touch, and the baby has become increasingly lethargic,unable to move the hands, unable to stretch the legs, and completely lacking active movement or reflexes, just lying completely still and weak. response: The patient is likely experiencing symptoms of postpartum hemorrhage or hypovolemic shock, possibly due to rapid labor or complications like uterine atony. Her complaints of weakness, dizzy spells, and blurred vision are classic signs of low blood pressure and inadequate tissue perfusion. You must immediately check her vital signs and estimate her blood loss to determine the severity. If she is hemodynamically unstable with significant blood loss, a blood transfusion is the priority to restore volume; however, she should not be forced to eat until she is stabilized. Immediate management should include IV fluid resuscitation, uterotonic drugs to ensure the uterus is contracting, and continuous monitoring of her pulse and blood pressure.
question:
Suddenly, we saw one of our pregnant women who came to our hospital this morning. She arrived in severe pain, crying loudly, holding her back and abdomen because of the pain.
After about eight to ten minutes of bringing her into the labour ward, we examined her and found that the baby was already descending and her cervix was fully dilated.
Very shortly afterward, she delivered a baby girl.
So we carried out all the necessary and appropriate post-delivery care.
Not long after, we moved the mother and baby into a room so they could rest.
A little while later, the mother called us and said she was feeling very weak, tired, and that her eyes seemed dim or blurry. She also tried to eat after delivery but struggled to do so, and the food was not going down well.
She continued to feel weak, and she was also feeling dizzy.
What could have happened? Could it be that she lost a lot of blood and now needs a blood transfusion, or what should be done for her? Should we give her blood, or should we give her food?

response: Based on the clinical presentation of poor crying, lethargy, hypotonia (stiffness/weakness), and feeding difficulties immediately after a normal delivery, the primary concerns are neonatal asphyxia, birth asphyxia, or severe neonatal sepsis. You must immediately perform the "Initial Neonatal Care" steps: clear the airway, provide warmth, stimulate the baby, and start bag-mask ventilation if breathing is inadequate. Diagnostic tests should include a blood gas analysis (to check for acidosis), a complete blood count (CBC), and a culture of blood and umbilical cord fluid to rule out infection. Emergency management requires stabilizing the baby's airway and circulation, potentially administering oxygen, intravenous fluids, and broad-spectrum antibiotics. In our local setting, rapid intervention in the first "golden hour" is critical to prevent permanent neurological damage or death.
question:
A 30-year-old woman gave birth a few minutes ago. The delivery was said to be normal. However, since the baby was born, the baby has been having serious difficulty. The baby is not crying well and is not responding as a newborn should.
After birth, the baby did not cry properly, and seems to have difficulty waking up. The body seems stiff or not moving properly as expected. The baby also cannot feed well and is struggling to breastfeed.

response: Based on the clinical presentation of fever (38.8°C), shivering, and generalized body aches (myalgia) in a postpartum mother in Nigeria, malaria is a highly probable diagnosis. Paracetamol is appropriate for immediate symptom management of fever and pain, but it does not treat the underlying infection. You must ensure she receives the standard antimalarial treatment (such as Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy) as per national guidelines, as paracetamol alone is insufficient. Monitor her for "danger signs" like severe headache, confusion, or heavy vaginal bleeding, which require urgent escalation. Ensure she maintains adequate hydration and nutrition to support recovery and breastfeeding.
question: This lady gave birth at our place this morning; she delivered the baby at dawn. When she arrived around 8:00 AM, the person who was with her at home called us, saying this lady was shivering, her body was very hot, and she had a lot of body issues which really bothered her. We went to see the lady, covered her with a cloth, and checked her temperature—meaning how hot her body was—and it was 38.2. We performed a malaria test for this lady, that is, a malaria rapid test diagnosis was done. This lady is not well, it looks like malaria. We asked if she had eaten, and she said she hadn't eaten anything. We told those who were with her to give her tea, to let the lady drink it. Has she breastfed the baby? She said when she wanted to breastfeed the baby, she noticed the baby passed stool/had a bowel movement. We then asked the lady to sit up and lean back on the bed she was on, to let her body recover better—not completely, but to help—and her eyes were not white/pale. So, we advised that once she has eaten, she should take Paracetamol. After she has finished taking the Paracetamol, we decided how many days it will be before we can give it to the lady again. She has malaria, and we performed a malaria test. Please, we can give it to her again. Once she has finished eating, and we have advised her to take Paracetamol, since she is feeling weak, if it doesn't go away, we will know what kind of treatment to provide.

response: The symptoms described, particularly severe coughing and difficulty breathing in a child, are highly suggestive of acute lower respiratory tract infections such as pneumonia or severe bronchitis. In our local setting, these are often caused by bacterial or viral pathogens, which lead to inflammation and fluid accumulation in the lungs, making it hard for oxygen to reach the bloodstream. The breathing becomes difficult because the airways are narrowed or blocked, forcing the child to work harder to inhale and exhale. This is a medical emergency; the child must be taken to the nearest hospital immediately for oxygen therapy, nebulization, and appropriate antibiotics or antivirals. Early intervention is critical to prevent respiratory failure and complications.
question:
A caregiver who is taking care of a small child noticed that the child she is caring for is struggling to breathe, and the child's breathing is not normal.
She also noticed that the child coughs repeatedly, and the cough is very severe.
The child is not a baby that was abandoned at birth, nor a child that is usually bathed with cold water.
What then can cause a small child to be breathing with difficulty and coughing repeatedly, and why would breathing not be easy for the child as it should be? What can be done about this situation?

response: The child's symptoms, specifically the persistent cough, nocturnal respiratory distress, and audible chest movements, are highly suggestive of **pediatric pneumonia** or **acute bronchitis**, which are common in our community due to environmental factors and respiratory infections. The breathing difficulty occurs because inflammation or fluid in the lungs impairs gas exchange, forcing the child to work harder to breathe (increased work of breathing). You must watch for **danger signs** such as rapid breathing, chest indrawing (the chest sinking in), bluish lips/fingernails (cyanosis), or extreme lethargy, which require immediate emergency care. To manage this at home, avoid giving over-the-counter cough syrups without a prescription, ensure the child stays hydrated, and keep the environment free from smoke, dust, and heavy fumes. Please bring the child to the clinic immediately for a physical examination, pulse oximetry, and appropriate antibiotic or supportive treatment.
question:
A mother noticed that for the past few days, her child had started coughing continuously. At first, she thought it was a cold affecting the child’s chest and that it would go away. However, the cough did not improve. Every night, the child wakes up suddenly because of the cough. Sometimes, the child struggles as if it is difficult to breathe properly. The mother would carry the child upright and could hear the chest working while the child was breathing. This makes it difficult for the child to sleep well at night.
One day, after a night during which the child coughed severely and struggled to breathe properly, the mother decided to go to the hospital. She wanted to know what was causing the cough, what was causing the breathing difficulty, and how she could help the child.
My question is: what could cause a child to cough severely and have difficulty breathing, especially at night? What danger signs should they watch out for when the child is coughing? What things should they avoid in order to prevent or reduce this cough?

response: Given the sub-acute to chronic progression of a cough lasting over three months, the primary clinical suspicion is pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB), which is highly prevalent in Nigeria. His symptoms of worsening dyspnea and failure to respond to over-the-counter remedies are classic "red flags" for a bacterial infection or underlying chronic lung pathology. The previous home remedies failed because they only addressed superficial symptoms rather than the underlying causative pathogen or structural damage. I would perform a sputum acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear and a chest X-ray to confirm a diagnosis of tuberculosis or other chronic respiratory infections. To regain his health, he requires a structured clinical treatment plan, likely involving a multi-drug anti-tuberculosis regimen (DOTS) and pulmonary rehabilitation.
question: A man named Suberu, who is fifty years old, developed a cough one day. At first, the cough was mild, but as the weeks passed and turned into months, it gradually became worse. After some time, he began to find it difficult to breathe properly. It is true that he had tried several remedies when the cough was still mild, but none of them worked. Instead of improving, the cough continued to worsen. He eventually decided that rather than continuing to buy small medications on his own, he should go to the hospital and speak with a doctor. When he arrived at the hospital, he explained that he had been coughing for about three months. He also explained that he had tried many home remedies based on people's advice, including honey, hot water, bitter kola, and several cough medicines that he purchased. However, instead of getting better, the cough continued to worsen. It had reached a point where he sometimes felt as though he could no longer breathe properly because of the cough. He then asked the doctor what could be causing him to have such a persistent cough for such a long period of time. Finally, he asked what he could do for the cough to go away completely so that he could breathe properly again and regain good health.

response: Based on these severe symptoms, your child likely has **meningitis** or a **subarachnoid hemorrhage**, which are medical emergencies often caused by bacterial or viral infections. The fever and "stiff neck" (nuchal rigidity) occur because the lining of the brain and spinal cord is inflamed, causing intense pain and muscle spasms. You must take the child to the nearest hospital immediately for a physical examination, including a neurological assessment and a lumbar puncture to check for infection. Laboratory results may show an elevated white blood cell count, high inflammatory markers, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis showing low glucose or high protein levels. Please do not delay; these conditions can lead to permanent brain damage or death if not treated with intravenous antibiotics or fluids urgently.
question: My name is Titilola. Since yesterday, my child's body has been burning, shivering intensely. The child cannot turn their neck at all. response: The symptoms described—severe morning cough, progressive shortness of breath (dyspnea) on exertion, and rapid fatigue—could indicate chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), bronchiectasis, or congestive heart failure. This condition is not limited to the lungs; heart diseases, such as mitral stenosis or heart failure, often present with similar respiratory distress due to pulmonary congestion. Severe breathing difficulties or death can be caused by acute respiratory failure, severe pneumonia, pulmonary embolism, or sudden cardiac arrest. The family must seek urgent medical attention if they notice "danger signs" such as bluish lips or fingernails (cyanosis), gasping for air, inability to speak in full sentences, or a rapid, shallow pulse. Early clinical evaluation is essential to differentiate between primary pulmonary issues and cardiac complications.
question:

As time goes on, she also notices that her husband struggles to breathe properly. When he walks a little distance or climbs stairs, he stops to catch his breath and becomes tired very quickly.
One day, after her husband spent a long time coughing and trying to regain his breath, the wife became worried. She started thinking that maybe there is a disease causing all these problems. response: The excessive bleeding following childbirth is likely Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH) or secondary postpartum hemorrhage, often caused by uterine atony (failure of the uterus to contract), retained products of conception, or lacerations. To stop the bleeding, the patient needs immediate clinical assessment for a pelvic exam, potential administration of uterotonics like oxytocin or misoprostol, and possibly manual removal of retained tissue. To regain strength, she requires intravenous fluids for rehydration and blood transfusions if her hemoglobin levels are critically low due to blood loss. I advise the mother to seek emergency medical care immediately, as severe bleeding can lead to life-threatening shock. For the daughter, I recommend proper wound care and monitoring for signs of infection or persistent heavy bleeding.
question:

response: Given that your child has been symptomatic for two months and has tested negative for Tuberculosis, the persistent cough and nocturnal breathing difficulty could be caused by asthma, chronic bronchitis, or a persistent lower respiratory tract infection. In our clinical setting, asthma is a common cause of nighttime wheezing and coughing, often triggered by dust, allergens, or cold air. Alternatively, a parasitic infection or persistent pneumonia could also present with these symptoms if not fully cleared by initial treatment. I recommend a thorough physical examination, including listening to his lungs (auscultation) and potentially a chest X-ray, to rule out other underlying causes. Please do not continue self-medicating with TB drugs, as they do not treat asthma or other types of chronic coughs.
question:

response: Based on your description of the "whistling" sound (wheezing), chest indrawing, and difficulty feeding, your child is showing signs of severe lower respiratory distress, likely due to **Bronchiolitis or Pneumonia**. The chest indrawing and inability to eat indicate that his work of breathing is so high that he cannot coordinate swallowing, which is a medical emergency. You must bring him to a hospital immediately for oxygen therapy and injectable medications, as home remedies or over-the-counter cough syrups cannot treat the underlying inflammation or infection. A chest X-ray is necessary to confirm the extent of the infection and guide specific antibiotic or antiviral treatment. Do not attempt to treat this at home; prompt clinical intervention is required to prevent respiratory failure.
question:

response: The patient’s presentation of heavy intermenstrual bleeding and history of previous episodes suggests several possibilities, including uterine fibroids, endometrial polyps, or a possible ectopic pregnancy, which is a surgical emergency. Immediate stabilization must focus on aggressive fluid resuscitation with isotonic crystalloids and, if hemodynamically unstable, a blood transfusion to correct volume loss. Pharmacological management should prioritize uterotonic drugs like Oxytocin or Misoprostol to induce uterine contractions and minimize blood loss. For diagnostic clarity, an urgent ultrasound and a serum beta-hCG test are essential to rule out pregnancy-related complications and identify structural abnormalities. If she is hemodynamically stable but bleeding persists, a pelvic examination and potential surgical intervention (such as a D&C or myomectomy) may be necessary.
question: A woman was brought to the hospital this morning because she was bleeding heavily, and this had caused her a great deal of distress. response: The child's symptoms—fever, cough, and a generalized seizure (body stiffness, fainting, and excessive salivation)—strongly resemble **Febrile Seizures**, likely triggered by a common childhood infection like malaria or pneumonia. These conditions are treatable with prompt medical intervention to manage the underlying infection and control seizures. You must avoid herbal mixtures like "agbo" or traditional soaps, as they are unregulated, can be toxic, and may cause severe dehydration or poisoning. Instead, the child needs immediate clinical assessment to receive appropriate antimalarials or antibiotics and safe anticonvulsants if necessary. Please bring the child to the hospital immediately for professional treatment to ensure their safety and recovery.
question: A nursing mother noticed her child coughing and also suspected that the child's body was warm at certain times. She further stated that a few hours ago, she noticed that the child's entire body became stiff and she fainted, and she couldn't confirm that her lips were stable anymore as they were secreting fluid, and the child could no longer swallow any food. Gbogbo ẹsẹ̀, ọwọ́ àti ojú òun ni ó wú. Òun sì ti ń gbìyànjú láti tọ́jú ara rẹ̀. Wọ́n ní kí òun máa mu àwọn oògùn tí wọ́n fún un, ṣùgbọ́n òun kò rí ìyàtọ̀ kankan. A fi lọ́kàn balẹ̀ pé yóò rí ìmúláradá.
Nígbà tí a yẹ ara rẹ̀ wò, kò sí ààmì ìṣòro míì tó ṣe pàtàkì. Gbogbo ohun tó yẹ ká yẹ̀ wò ni a yẹ̀ wò, kò sì sí ohun míì tó dá wa láàmú. Ó tún lè gùn òkè láìsí ìṣòro. Nígbà tí a wọn ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀, ó jẹ́ 168/100 mmHg. A ní kí ó sinmi díẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà a tún wọn ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀, ó sì jẹ́ 150/90 mmHg.
A rí i pé olóyún ni. Nítorí náà, a bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú ìfọ̀pá gíga pẹ̀lú oògùn tó yẹ fún àwọn olóyún, tí ó sì jẹ́ ààbò fún wọn láti lò. A tún ṣàlàyé fún un àwọn ohun tí kò gbọdọ̀ ṣe, pàápàá jùlọ kí ó yẹra fún wàhálà púpọ̀, kí ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀ má bà a gòkè síi.
