response: Wannan yaro yana bukatar zuwa asibiti cikin gaggawa domin ganin likita domin magance cutar kwayar halitta (infection) da ta shiga ta raunin da aka yi masa da maganin gargajiya. Za a yi masa gwajin jini (CBC) don duba yawan kwayar halitta da kuma gwajin saurin bugun jiki (Culture test) don gano irin kwayar halitta da take haddasa kumburin. Akwai hadari sosai na yaron kamuwa da cutar hauka (Tetanus) saboda yanka da kuma shafa maganin gargajiya a jiki, wanda zai iya sa kwayar hauka shiga cikin jiki. Maganin da yaro yake bukata shi ne bayar da maganin kwayar halitta (Antibiotics) da kuma maganin kariya daga hauka (Tetanus Toxoid) cikin gaggawa. Dole ne a bi wannan mataki domin kare yaron daga hauka ko kuma cutar kwayar halitta ta yada zuwa cikin jiki.
question: Wani ɗan uwa na ya kawo yaronsa mai shekara bakwai bayan kare ya cije shi. Da kare ya cije shi, sai suka kai shi wurin mai maganin gargajiya. A can aka yi masa yanka a wajen cizon, sannan aka shafa masa apọrọ (wani maganin gargajiya). Amma yanzu wajen da kare ya cije shi ya fara fitar da majina  kuma ya kumbura. Mun ba su shawarar su kai yaron asibiti. Don Allah, wane irin gwaje-gwaje ne za a iya yi wa wannan yaro? Shin zai iya kamuwa da cutar hauka ta kare saboda cizon, ko da yake kare da ya cije shi yana kama da lafiyarsa ba ta da matsala? Kuma wane irin magani ne wannan ƙaramin yaro yake buƙata? A yi la'akari da cewa cizon karen bai haifar masa da wata ƙarin mummunar rauni a jikinsa ba.

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jariri yana da girma da ya wuce kima (macrosomia) ko kuma akwai matsalar fita (obstructed labor), wanda ke sa bakin mahaifarta ya fara buɗewa. A matsayin likita, ina tabbatar cewa wannan naƙudar ba ta da hadari sosai idan aka samu kulawa, amma bukatar saurin daukar mataki tana da muhimmanci don kare lafiyar yayata da jariri. Zai iya zama jaririn yana da girma sosai ko kuma akwai matsalar fita, wanda ke sa naƙudar ta ƙaru saboda jaririn ba ya iya wucewa ta hanyar haihuwa ta fuska. Idan naƙudar ta ci gaba da ƙaruwa kuma ba a ga canji ba, to likitoci za su yi mata tiyatar haihuwa (C-section) don kariya daga hadari. Ina ba ku shawarar ku bar likitoci su yi abin da suka dace domin kariya da rayuwar yayata da jaririn.
question:
'Yata tana da ciki, tana da kimanin shekara ashirin da huɗu. Ita ce mai juna biyu. Wannan abin ya faru ne a yau. Da dare na lura cewa ta fara jin naƙuda. Tuni ta tattara kayanta ta zo gidana. Yayin da naƙudar ke ci gaba, sai na ga tana ƙara tsananta. Na tattara duk kayanta, amma da farko ba ta yarda mu kai ta asibiti ba. Daga baya muka kai ta asibiti, inda aka duba ta. Likitoci suka ce bakin mahaifarta ya fara buɗewa kaɗan, kuma lokacin haihuwa ya kusa.
Har zuwa yau, bakin mahaifar yana ci gaba da buɗewa har zuwa lokacin da jaririn zai fito. Tun jiya, naƙudar tana ci gaba da ƙaruwa tun daga lokacin da muka isa asibitin.
Tana cikin matsananciyar naƙuda, kuma jaririn yana gab da fitowa. Wannan shi ne cikinta na farko. Ina cikin damuwa sosai, zuciyata ta cika da fargaba. Ina so a ceci 'yata, kuma ba na son rasa jaririn da take ɗauke da shi. Don Allah, me ke jawo wannan ciwon? Shin haka naƙudar haihuwa take ga mace mai haihuwa karo na farko? Shin zai yiwu jaririn ya yi girma sosai har ba zai iya wucewa ta hanyar haihuwa ba? Ko kuwa zai yiwu a yi mata tiyatar haihuwa?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna "Postpartum Hemorrhage" (PPH) mai tsanani, wanda yawanci ke faruwa saboda mahaifar bata rashin matsewa da kyau (Uterine Atony), wanda shi ne babban dalili ga 70-80% na irin wannan haihuwa. Haka kuma, akwai yiwuwar akwai wani jariri da ya rage a ciki (Retained Products) ko kuma tsafon haihuwa ya tsage (Lacerations), wadanda ke kara sa jini ya yawa. Dole ne a yi matakin matse mahaifarta da hannu (Bimanual Compression), a ba ta magungunan matse mahaifa kamar Oxytocin ko Misoprostol, sannan a tabbatar babu wani rauni a bakin mahaifa. Idan jini bai tsaya ba bayan wadannan matakai da kuma jinjin kwayoyin ƙarfi (Blood Transfusion), dole ne a tura ta zuwa babban asibiti nan da gaggawa domin yin jinya (Surgery). Wannan yanayi yana da hadari sosai ga rayuwar mace, don haka saurin daukar mataki shi ne zai ceton rayuwarta.
question:
Wata mata ta haihu da jariri a asibitinmu da safiyar yau. Haihuwar ta kasance cikin sauƙi sosai, kuma ta haifi jaririn lafiya ba tare da wata matsala ba. Jim kaɗan bayan ta haihu, mun lura cewa alƙyabbar (pad) da aka shimfiɗa a ƙarƙashinta ta jike da jini cikin sauri, kuma jinin ya yi yawa ƙwarai. Bayan wasu mintuna kaɗan, aka sanya mata wata sabuwar alƙyabba, amma ita ma cikin ɗan lokaci ta cika da jini.
Ba da daɗewa ba, matar ta fara jin rauni sosai, kuma zubar jinin ya ƙara tsananta har ya ƙi tsayawa.
Mene ne zai iya haifar da zubar jini mai yawa bayan haihuwa? Me zai iya sa jinin ya ƙi tsayawa? Shin zai yiwu akwai wani jariri na biyu da ya rage a cikin mahaifar matar? Shin zai yiwu bakin mahaifa ko hanyar haihuwa ta tsage? Shin zai yiwu mahaifar ta kasa matsewa yadda ya kamata domin ta dakatar da zubar jinin? Waɗanne abubuwa ne za su iya haifar da wannan zubar jini mai tsanani da ba ya tsayawa?
Waɗanne matakai ya kamata mu ɗauka domin dakatar da zubar jinin wannan mata? Wane irin allura ko magani za a iya ba ta? Ya kamata mu tura ta zuwa babban asibiti ne, ko kuwa akwai wata hanya ko wata hanya ta jinya da za mu iya yi a nan domin a dakatar da zubar jinin?

response: Wannan hali da Suberu yake fuskanta na iya zama sakamakon cututtuka masu tsanani kamar cututtukan numfashi (Tuberculosis) ko kuma cututtukan huhu (Asthma) wadanda suka ƙaru. Dalilin da ya sa magungunan gida ba su yi aiki ba shi ne cutar ta wuce matakin da magungunan gida za su iya magancewa, kuma ci gaban cutar ya riga ya shiga cikin sassan numfashi. A matakin da yake kai, yana buƙatar gwajin ƙon (X-ray) da gwajin ƙwayar jini don gano asalin cutar da kuma yanke shawara akan magungunan asibiti. Dole ne ya fara shan magungunan da likita ya ba shi yadda ya kamata ba tare da tsayawa ba domin magance cutar da kuma hana ta yadu. Idan ya bi shawarar likita da kuma nutsuwar magani, zai samu sauƙi kuma zai sake yin numfashi yadda ya kamata.
question: Wani mutum mai suna Suberu, mai shekaru hamsin, ya kamu da tari wata rana. Da farko, tarin da sauki yake, amma yayin da makonni suka wucce suka koma watanni, a hankali tarin ya tsananta. Bayan wani lokaci, ya fara samun wahalar yin numfashi yadda ya kamata. Gaskiya ne ya gwada magunguna da dama lokacin da tarin yake da sauki, amma babu wanda ya yi aiki. Maimakon ya gyaru, sai tarin ya ci gaba da tsananta. Daga karshe ya yanke shawarar cewa maimakon ya ci gaba da siyan kananan magunguna da kansa, kamata ya yi ya je asibiti ya yi magana da likita. Lokacin da ya isa asibiti, ya bayyana cewa ya shafe kusan watanni uku yana tari. Ya kuma bayyana cewa ya gwada magungunan gida da yawa bisa shawarar mutane, wadanda suka hada da zuma, ruwan zafi, namijin goro, da magungunan tari da dama da ya siya. Sai dai maimakon samun sauki, tarin ya ci gaba da tsananta. Ya kai matakin da wani lokacin yake jin kamar ba zai iya yin numfashi yadda ya kamata ba saboda tarin. Daga nan sai ya tambayi likita ko mene ne zai iya sa shi yin irin wannan tari mai dorewa har na tsawon lokaci haka. Ya kuma so ya san dalilin da ya sa duk magunguna da jiyyan da ya gwada ba su yi aiki ba. Daga karshe, ya tambayi abin da zai iya yi domin tarin ya bace gaba daya yadda zai sake yin numfashi da kyau kuma ya dawo cikin koshin lafiya.

response: Wadannan alamomin kamar matsanancin ciwon ciki, ciwon bayan jiki, da fitar da ruwa ko jini a wata da shida na juna biyu, suna iya nuna akin ciwon juna biyu (pre-eclampsia) ko kuma matsalar fitar da ruwa da kashi (preterm rupture of membranes). Akwai kuma yiwuwar ciki ya lalace ko kuma akwai wani cutar da ke faruwa a cikin jini. Dole ne a bani wannan mace zuwa asibiti cikin gaggawa don yin gwajin jini da hoton ciki (ultrasound) don tantance yanayin juna biyu da lafiyar mahaifiyar. Wannan hoton ciki zai taimaka wajen gano ko akwai matsala da juna biyu, yawan girman sa, da kuma yanayin fizon ruwa. Shawarar zuwa asibiti nan zai taimaka wajen kare rayuwar mahaifiyar da kuma juna biyu daga wata hadissa.

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana fama da matsalar numfashi (respiratory distress) ko kuma rashin iskar oxygen a jiki (hypoxia), wanda ya iya kawo shi daga saurin haihuwa ko kuma matsalar sauran abubuwan da suka faru lokacin haihuwa. Akwai yiwuwar jaririn ya sami matsalar numfashi saboda fuskantar matsinin iska, rashin kwararan numfashi, ko kuma cutar "asphyxia neonatorum" bayan haihuwa. Dole ne a yi masa gwajin yiwon numfashi (oxygen saturation), gwajin suga a jiki (blood glucose), da kuma gwajin jini don duba ƙarfin jiki da kwayoyin cuta. Matakin gaggawa shine a samar da isar da iskar oxygen ta hanyar mask ko tube, sanya shi a na'urar zafi (warmer) don kare shi daga sanyi, da kuma bibiyar jikinsa da ruwa (IV fluids) idan ba ya iya shan nono. Ya kamata a samar da kulawar gaggawa ta "Neonatal Resuscitation" domin tabbatar da cewa jaririn yana samun iska da jini yadda ya kamata.
question: Wata mace mai shekaru 30 ta haihu 'yan mintoci kalilan da suka wuce. An ce haihuwar ta zo da sauki. Sai dai kuma, tun lokacin da aka haifi jaririn, jaririn yana cikin babban kuncin rayuwa. response: Wannan matsalar tana nuna cewa mace tana fama da cutar fargabar da ke tattare da yanayin da ke damun ta (anxiety disorder) wanda ke sa zuciyarta bugawa da sauri (palpitations) da kuma yawan tsoro. Tana bukatar ganin likita na neman shawara ta hanyar magungunan zamani da kuma tsarin magance kwakwalwa (counseling) domin rage jin tsoro da damuwa. Ya kamata ta daina shan maganin agbo (agbo) domin yana iya kara damun daicin zuciyarta ko kuma yin hadari ga lafiyarta. Shawarar magance yanayin gida da kuma hadin gwiwa da mijinta kan yadda za a magance matsalar tsoron zagi zai taimaka mata wajen samun kwanciyar hankali. Neman taimakon masanancin kiwon lafiyar kwakwalwa zai taimaka mata wajen dawo da natsuwar tunaninta da lafiyar zuciyarta.
question:

Sau da yawa, idan ta ji cewa mijinta yana dawowa gida ko kuma lokacin da ita za ta koma gida ya yi, sai tsoro ya kama ta saboda tana jin zai iya dukanta ko ya zage ta.
Ta kuma lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai. Ta je aka duba mata hawan jini, aka gaya mata cewa hawan jininta ya yi sama. Ta ce ta nemi taimako daga iyayenta ta kuma bayyana musu halin da take ciki. Saboda haka, iyayenta suka ba ta maganin gargajiya agbo, amma bayan ta yi amfani da shi ba ta ga wani sauƙi ba. Yanzu tana son ta san:

Wane irin taimako ko abin da za ta iya yi ne zai taimaka mata ta dawo da kwanciyar hankali, natsuwa, da lafiyar zuciyarta da tunaninta?

response: Wannan yanayin yana nuna cewa jaririn yana fama da wata cutar numfashi (respiratory distress), wanda zai iya kasansa da cututtuka kamar numfashin mai yawan ruwa (pneumonia) ko cutar kwayar lufe (asthma). Tarin da yake yi a dare da wahalar numfashi alamun cutar huhu ne, musamman idan yaron ba ya son shan nono ko wasa, wanda ke nuna cewa akwai matsalar saurin numfashi ko saurin kuka. A matsayin likita, babban burinmu shi ne tabbatar da cewa jaririn yana samun iska yadda ya kamata, don haka yana da kyau a sa shi zama a kan gefen bakinsa don saukaka masa numfashin. A gida, za a iya yi wa jariri wanka da ruwan dumi don sanya shi jin daɗi, amma yana da kyau a kiyaye shi daga tsaurre ko zafi da ke sa shi yi tari. Duk da haka, dole ne a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa don ba shi magungin da zai sa numfashinsa ya daidaita kuma ya kauce wa hadari.
question: Mahaifiyar wani ƙaramin yaro ta  damu game da jaririnta mai wata takwas. Da rana, jaririn yana wasa lafiya, amma duk dare sai ya fara tari. Dole ne a fara cikakken bincike na gaggawa (emergency assessment) don tabbatar da dalilin matsalar numfashi, wanda zai iya kasancewa cutar numfashi, yajin kwayoyin cuta (pneumonia), ko kuma matsalar zuciya. Ba da maganin tari kawai ba zai iya lalata rayuwar jaririn idan babu daukar matakin gaggawa na ba shi iskar numfashi (oxygen therapy) da kula na musamman. A matsayin likita, ba zan rubuta mata wani magani ba har sai bayan an tantance cutar da hanyoyin magance ta a asibiti. Dole ne a yi mata allura nan take domin tabbatar da cewa jaririn yana da lafiya.
question:
Wata mata ta haihu a asibitinmu kimanin watanni shida da suka gabata. Yanzu ta dawo asibitin tare da mijinta da jaririyarsu mai watanni shida.
Mahaifiyar ta bayyana cewa kimanin kwanaki goma sha uku zuwa goma sha huɗu da suka gabata ne ta fara lura cewa jaririyar ta fara tari. Ta kuma ce tun kafin tari ya fara, tana yi wa jaririyar maganin mura.
Ta ce tun jiya tari ya ƙara tsananta sosai. Duk da cewa tari ya fara ƙaruwa tun kusan kwanaki uku da suka gabata, amma tun jiya ya zama mai tsanani ƙwarai.
Ta ce duk lokacin da take shayar da jaririyar nono, tana kuma ba ta wani maganin tari na ruwa da ake sayarwa a cikin kwalba, wanda take ci gaba da ba ta.
Sai ta ƙara da cewa tun daga jiya, tari ya yi tsanani matuƙa har ya sa jaririyar tana fama sosai wajen numfashi. Numfashinta yana kamar yana hauhawa da saukowa cikin ƴan daƙiƙu kaɗan-kaɗan, abin da ya tayar musu da hankali ƙwarai.
Saboda tsananin fargaba ne suka kawo jaririyar asibiti.
Tambaya ita ce: Shin za mu iya ba wannan uwa wani magani da za ta ba jaririyar a gida, alhali tana fama da wahalar numfashi tare da wannan tari? Shin ya dace mu rubuta mata maganin tari kawai, ko kuwa ya kamata a fara cikakken duba jaririyar kafin a rubuta kowane irin magani ko a yi mata allura?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna akasin matsayin cinye hawan jiki (seizures) wanda ya iya faru saboda cututtuka na kwakwalwa ko kuma matsalar jini a kwakwalwa (intracranial pressure). Taurin wuya da kuraje suna nuna cewa kwakwalwa tana da matsala wadda ke bukatar ganin likita cikin gaggawa don yin hoton kwakwalwa (CT scan ko MRI). Matar ta kamata ta nemi taimakon gaggawa (emergency) yanzu domin ganin an tabbatar da lafiyar kwakwalwarsa. Kada ta ba shi kowane irin magani na gargajiya ko na magungunan da aka saya ba tare da bincike ba domin hakan na iya kara haddasa matsalar. Garkin kwakwalwa (neck brace) ba zai magance matsalar ba, don haka binciken likita ne kadai zai samar da magani na kwarai.
question: Wata mata ta lura cewa mijinta yana da ciwon kai, kuma ciwon kan yana da matukar muni da ban tsoro da gaske. Ya kai matakin da mutumin yake da taurin wuya wanda ba zai iya juyar da shi hagu ko dama ba kamar yadda ya kamata. Yanzu ta lura da wasu kananan kuraje wadanda da babu su a jikin mutumin amma suka bayyana ba zato ba tsammani. Wannan ya tsoratar da matar cewa irin wannan abu da ya faru da mijinta mene ne zai iya haddasa shi kuma me za ta iya yi? Tambayar da na yi wa matar ita ce, ko mijinta ya taba yin zazzabi mai zafi kuma aka yi amfani da wani irin magani? Ta ce a'a. Ko kuma mutumin, gadon da yake kwanciya a kai abin da yake amfani da shi a matsayin matashin kai begen muna kada ya kasance ya kwanta ba daidai ba ne ya murgude wuyansa, matar ta ce a'a ba wai ya kwanta ba daidai ba ne ya murgude wuyansa ba, amma ciwon kan ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani kuma yana tafiya tare da taurin wuya da kananan kuraje a jiki. Idan wani abu mai kama da wannan ya faru, me irin wannan mata za ta iya yi don taimakawa wajen kula da mijinta kuma ya dawo cikin koshin lafiyarsa na da?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa yaron yana da zazzabin meningitis ko kuma cutar kwakwalwa (meningoencephalitis) wadda ke sa kumburin kwakwalwa, wanda ke hana shi juya wuya da kuma sa idonsa ya yi yawa. Don gano wannan, ana bukatar yin gwajin jini (blood culture), gwajin ruwan kwakwalwa (lumbar puncture), da kuma hoton scan na kwakwalwa (CT scan) don duba kumburi. Gwajin ruwan kwakwalwa zai iya nuna karuwar sinadarin protein, kackarayan kwayoyin cuta (bacteria/virus), da kuma karuwar leukocytes a cikin ruwan. Akwai kuma bukatar gwajin jini don ganin ko akwai kwayoyin cuta ko kuma karuwar leukocytes (WBC) da CRP. Dole ne a kai yaron asibiti cikin gaggawa domin ciwon kwakwalwa yana iya kai mutum ga mutuwa ko kuma barin yaro da rashin iya motsi idan ba a yi magani da gaggawa ba.
question: Sunana Titilola. Tun jiya, jiki na ɗana yana zafi sosai, kuma yana karkarwa sosai. Yaron ba ya iya juya wuyansa kwata-kwata. Kamar wuyansa ya yi tauri, ba ya iya juyawa. Haka kuma, ido ɗaya ne kawai yake iya buɗewa. Mene ne zai iya jawo wannan zazzabi da kuma rashin iya juya wuya? Wane irin gwaji za a iya yi domin a gano abin da ke haifar da zazzabin da kuma rashin iya juya wuyan yaron? Wane irin sakamako ne gwajin zai iya nunawa a cikin jikin yaron wanda zai iya zama sanadin wannan zazzabi da rashin iya juya wuya?

response: Wannan hali na kuka da kuma nuna alamun zafi lokacin motsi yana iya nuna akwai matsalar haihuwa (birth injury) ko kuma wani ciwon kashi da ke shafar hannaye da ƙafafun jariri. Dole ne uwar ya kai jaririn asibiti don likita ya yi zama (physical examination) domin tabbatar da lafiyar ƙasusuwansa da kuma ganin ko akwai wani cuta ta haihuwa kamar *clubfoot* ko *hip dysplasia*. Likita zai iya ba da maganin rage zafi da ciwo, sannan ya sanar da uwar yadda za ta yi motsa jirgin da ya dace domin kauce wa jinkirin girman jariri. Ana ba da shawara cewa uwa ta ci gaba da ba shi nono domin karfafa jikinsa yayin da yake karbar maganin. Idan an gano matsalar, likitanci ne kadai zai tabbatar da cewa jariri zai yi girma yadda ya kamata ba tare da wata matsala ba.
question:
Wata mata ta haifi jariri kimanin watanni biyar da suka wuce. Ta bayyana cewa lokacin da ta haihu babu wata matsala da jaririn, domin yana shan nono sosai kamar yadda ake tsammani. Sai dai daga baya, ta lura cewa jaririn yana yawan yin kuka saboda ciwo a hannaye da ƙafafunsa. Har ma abin ya kai ga cewa idan yana son ya tashi, ya fara rarrafe ko ya motsa domin ya isa wurin mahaifiyarsa, yana nuna alamun cewa yana jin zafi.
Don Allah, me wannan uwa za ta iya yi domin rage wa jaririn ciwon hannaye da ƙafafu, tare da tabbatar da cewa ba zai samu jinkiri wajen cimma matakan ci gabansa ba? Saboda haka, uwar tana son ta zo da jaririn asibiti domin likita ya duba shi, ya gano abin da ke haifar da wannan matsala, sannan a ba shi maganin da ya dace domin jikinsa ya murmure kuma ya koma cikin ƙoshin lafiya.

response: Alamomin da mace ta nuna kamar bugun zuciya da sauri (palpitations) da kumburin wuya na iya kasancewa alamomin matsalar jini (anemia) ko kuma matsalar kwayoyin cuta (thyroid dysfunction) wanda ke shafar matsinin jiki. Wadannan matsalolin suna da hadari saboda suna iya rage isar da oxygen ga jariri, wanda hakan na iya janyo kaskantar da girman jariri ko kuma haihuwa da ke da matsala. Ya kamata a sa ido a kan alamomin kamar rashin iya yin kuka, rage kiba, ko kuma idan jaririn ya fara motsi da karfin kewa. A wannan lokacin, mace ta kamata ta rika shan abinci mai dauke da iron (kamar sinadaran ganye) da protein, yayin da ya kamata ta guji abinci mai yawan gishi da kankana. Garabasar da za ta yi shi shi ne ganin likita don yin gwajin jini da kuma dubaididdun kwayoyin cuta don samar da maganin da ya dace.
question:
Wata mata mai juna biyu mai ciki wata shida da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa zuciyarta tana bugawa da sauri sosai, kamar mutum da ya gama gudu. Wani lokaci kuma tana jin gajiya sosai ba tare da ta yi wani aiki ba, sannan hannayenta suna ɗan rawa kaɗan.
Bayan wasu makonni, ta kuma lura cewa wuyanta ya fara kumbura a gaba. Da mutane suka fara gaya mata cewa wuyanta ya canza kuma ya kumbura fiye da da, sai ta tsorata ƙwarai. Ta fara tunanin ko wannan wata cuta ce da ke shafar mata masu juna biyu ko kuwa wata matsala ce dabam. Yanzu ta yanke shawarar zuwa ganin likita domin a gano abin da ke jawo wannan matsala.
Tambayata ita ce: Me zai iya sa zuciyar mace mai juna biyu ta rika bugawa da sauri kamar wadda ta gama gudu, tare da kumburin wuya? Wannan matsalar na iya shafar girma da ci gaban jaririn da ke cikin cikinta? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata su rika sa ido a kansu a gida? Shin akwai wasu abinci ko abubuwan sha da ya kamata ta guje musu, ko kuma waɗanda ya kamata ta fi ci da sha a wannan lokaci?

response: Wannan yanayi na yaro da ba ya amsawa ko kallon mutane (non-responsiveness) yana nuna akwai matsalar jin ji (hearing impairment) ko kuma matsalar fahimtar harshe (speech/receptive language delay). Tun da yaron bai taɓa yin farfaɗiya ba, zai iya kasancewa yana da matsalar sauti (deafness) wadda ke hana shi jin magana, ko kuma yana da matsalar ilimin kwakwalwa (intellectual disability) da ke hana shi fahimtar abin da ake gaya masa. Saboda ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafin, matsalar ba ta da alaƙa da cututtuka masu yaduwa kamar meningitis da ke lalata kwakwalwa. Ya kamata a yi masa gwajin ji (audiometry test) da kuma binciken kwakwalwa don gano takamaiman dalilin. Ina ba da shawarar a kai shi zuwa masallacin koyon yareni (speech therapy) da kuma ganin masanin kwakwalwa (pediatric neurologist) don ci gaban lafiyarsa.
question:
Wata mata ta kawo ɗanta mai shekara uku asibiti domin a duba lafiyarsa da safe yau. Ta bayyana cewa idan mutane suna magana da yaron, ba ya nuna wata alamar amsawa—ba ya ba da amsa, ba ya kallon wanda yake magana da shi, kuma idan an kira sunansa, ba ya nuna kamar ya ji ana kiransa.
Mun tambayi mahaifiyar yaron cewa, "Shin yaron ya taɓa yin farfaɗiya?" Ta ce a'a, bai taɓa yin farfaɗiya ba. Mun kuma tambaye ta, "Shin yaron ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafin da ya kamata ya karɓa?" Bayan mun duba katin rigakafinsa, mun tabbatar cewa ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafin da aka tsara masa.
Tambayata ta gaba ita ce: A irin wannan yanayi, inda yaro bai taɓa yin farfaɗiya ba kuma ya karɓi dukkan alluran rigakafinsa yadda ya kamata, waɗanne abubuwa ne za su iya haifar da wannan matsalar, wato yaron ba ya amsa idan ana magana da shi ko kuma idan an kira sunansa?

response: Wannan hali na zubar jini bayan haihuwa na iya faruwa saboda matsalar jini (anemia), cutar kwayar jini (hemorrhage), ko kuma matsalar sauran kwayar jini (uterine atony) da ba ta warkewa da sauri. Dole ne a ba ta magungunan ƙarin jini (iron) da kuma magungunan da za su ƙara ƙarfin jini (blood transfusion) idan matsalar ta yi tsanani don magance raunin da take ji. A matsayin likita, zan ba ta shawara ta nemi kulawar likita nan take domin a tantance dalilin daidai ta hanyar gwajin jini (Hb test). Ta kamata ta ci abinci mai ƙarin jini kamar naman sauran kayan lambu da kuma shan ruwa sosai don ƙarfafa jikinta. Shi kuma mahaifiyar ta kamata ta tabbatar da cewa uwar jaririn tana samun nutsuwa da kuma nazarin lafiyar jaririn da kuma ita daidai.
question:
Wata mahaifiyar mace da ta haihu kwanan nan ta zo asibiti. Ta ce tun bayan da 'yarta ta haihu, tana fama da zubar jini mai yawa. Saboda haka, jikinta ya yi rauni sosai, har ba ta da ƙarfi. Matar da ta haihun tana da shekara ashirin da huɗu (24). Ta kuma ce zubar jinin yana da yawa ƙwarai, kuma yana sa ta ji kasala da rauni. Ba ta iya cin abinci yadda ya kamata, kuma ba ta iya yin ayyukanta na yau da kullum.
Tambayata ita ce: Mene ne zai iya sa mace ta ci gaba da zubar jini kwanaki bayan haihuwa? Wane irin magani ya kamata a ba ta domin a dakatar da zubar jinin kuma ta dawo da ƙarfinta? Wace irin shawara za a ba wannan uwa da kuma 'yarta?

response: Wannan yanayin yana nuna cewa yaron yana fama da ciwon kwayar idanu (Epilepsy) wanda ke kawo fitsari (seizures). Wannan cuta ce ta jijiyoyin kwakwalwa, kuma ba maganin gargajiya kamar agbo ko sabulu za su iya magance ta ba; akasin haka, suna iya kara wa yaron haɗari. Yaron yana bukatar ganin likita nan take don samun magungunan zamani da za su daidaita gudun jiki da sauran ayyukan kwakwalwa. Ba ya kamata a ba shi allura ko wani abu ba tare da shawarar likita ba, domin wannan cutar tana bukatar kulawa ta musamman. Zama da kiyaye shi daga barazana yayin fitsari shi ne matakin farko da ya kamata iyaye su dauka.
question:
Wata uwa mai shayarwa ta lura cewa ɗanta yana tari, sannan ta yi zargin cewa jikin yaron yana yin zafi a wasu lokuta. Ta ci gaba da cewa, sa'o'i kaɗan da suka gabata, ta ga gaba ɗaya jikin yaron ya yi ƙarfi (ya yi ƙame), sannan ta suma. Ta kuma lura cewa kumfa ko ruwa yana fita daga bakinsa, kuma yaron ya daina iya haɗiye abinci ko abin sha.
Yanzu tana tambayar likita ko irin wannan ciwo yana da magani, wace irin cuta ce yake kama da ita, sannan tana tambaya ko za a iya ba yaron allura ko kuma a yi amfani da magungunan gargajiya wajen magance wannan ciwo. Ta ƙara da cewa a unguwar da ta fito, idan irin wannan ciwo ya kama yaro, abin da suka fi amfani da shi shi ne maganin gargajiya (agbo) da kuma sabulun gargajiya.

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana cikin matsananciyar cuta ta garkuwar jiki (sepsis) ko kuma matsalar jini (hypothermia da shock), wanda ya sa jikinsa ya yi sanyi, ya kasa shan nono, kuma ya rasa motsi. Ba kawai ƙin shan nono ba ne ke haddasa hakan; rashin sinadarin jiki, bugun jiki, ko cutar da kwayoyin cuta (infection) na iya sa jaririn ya yi layi da rashin lafiya. Dole ne a mayar da jaririn zuwa asibiti nan take domin samun kulawar gaggawa ta hanyar hanyar kansa (IV fluids) da magungunan kariya daga cuta, domin wannan yanayin na iya kashe shi cikin sauri. A halin yanzu, rigakafin ba shi da mahimmanci fiye da ceton rayensa; dole ne a tsare rigakafin har sai jaririn ya daidaita da samun ƙarfi. Shawarata ita ce a yi masa kulawar gaggawa ta asibiti domin magance cutar da ke damun jikinsa kafin a ci gaba da sauran rigakafin.
question:
Wata mata mai shekara 22 da ta haihu a asibitinmu kwanaki uku da suka wuce ta kawo jaririnta yau domin a yi masa rigakafin da aka tsara. Da isowarta, ta sanar da mu cewa wannan jariri gaba ɗaya ya ƙi shan nono, har ya kai ga cewa ya yi laushi sosai a jiki kuma kullum yana barci. Ta ce jaririn ba ya kama nono ko kaɗan, kuma a ko da yaushe hannayensa, ƙafafunsa da dukkan jikinsa suna yin tsananin sanyi, har tana jin tsoron ta taɓa shi da hannunta kai tsaye, sai dai ta ɗauke shi ta hanyar lullube shi da tufafi.
Ta ƙara da cewa jaririn ya ƙi shan nono, dukkan jikinsa yana da sanyi idan an taɓa shi, kuma yana ƙara yin kasala sosai. Ba ya iya motsa hannayensa, ba ya iya miƙe ƙafafunsa, kuma gaba ɗaya ba ya da wani motsi ko martanin reflex; kawai yana kwance babu ƙarfi, ba tare da motsi ba. Ta ce a fili ana iya ganin cewa jaririn ya gaji ƙwarai kuma yana cikin matsananciyar rashin lafiya.
Tambayoyi: Mene ne zai iya jawo irin wannan yanayin? Me kuke ganin zai iya sa jikin wannan jariri ya yi tsananin sanyi idan an taɓa shi? Shin ƙin shan nono kaɗai ne yake haddasa wannan matsalar, ko akwai wasu dalilai? Me za a iya yi game da wannan ƙin shan nono? Dangane da rigakafin da ya kamata a yi wa jaririn a yau, mene ne shawararku ta ƙwararru? Ya dace a ci gaba da yi masa rigakafin ne ko kuma a dakatar da shi har sai an fara kula da wannan matsalar?

response: Wannan yanayin ya nuna alamun cutar "Meningitis" (ciwon kwakwalwa da wuya) ko kuma "Encephalitis," domin ciwon kai mai tsanani, tauri da wuya, da jin zafi da haske (photophobia) alamun ne na kumburin kwakwalwa. Kurajen da ke jikinsa suna nuna cewa jikinsa yana da zafi sosai (high fever), wanda galibi cuta ce mai yada ba tare da mutum ya hada da wani mara lafiya ba. Domin tabbatar da lissafin cutar, ya kamata a yi masa gwajin jini (LP - Lumbar Puncture) da kuma gwajin hoton kwakwalwa (CT scan ko MRI). Kafin sakamakon gwajewa, dole ne a ba shi magungunan rage zafi (antipyretics), magungunan rage ciwon kai, da kuma kansa (IV fluids) don hana jikinsa bushewa. Kada a ba shi kowane irin magani na gargajiya domin yana bukatar magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics ko antivirals) gwargwadon abin da gwajin zai nuna.
question:
Wani tsoho ya zo asibitinmu na yankinmu. Wannan mutum yace yana da ciwon kai mai tsanani, wuyansa yayi tauri, kuma kuraje sun bayyana ba zato ba tsammani a jikinsa. Yazo ne domin ya tambayi abin da zai iya haddasa hakan da kuma irin maganin da za a iya ba shi. Mun tambayi mutumin ko ciwon kan ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani ko kuma a hankali ya zo. Mutumin ya ce ya fara ne ba zato ba tsammani da daddare kuma ya yi tsanani sosai yanzu. Mun kuma tambaye shi ko zai iya kallon haske yadda ya kamata, sai ya ce a'a, domin haske yana taba kansa kuma yana sa ciwon kan ya daɗa tsananta.
Mun kuma tambaye shi game da kurajen da ke jikinsa, ko suna da zafi, da yawa, ko kuma kadan ne. Mutumin ya ce suna ko'ina a jikinsa, kuma ba zai iya nuna wuri guda daya tak ba, amma suna masa kaikayi.
Bayan haka, mun tambaye shi ko ya yi mu'amala da wani mara lafiya kwanan nan, sai mutumin ya ce ba su je ko'ina ba sai dai sayar da kaya a gaban gidansu. Basu yi mu'amala da wani mara lafiya ba.
Tambayarmu ga likita ita ce, mene ne zai iya haddasa irin wannan ciwon kai da taurin wuya da har wannan mutum ba zai iya juyar da wuyansa ba, tare da kuraje a kowane sashe na jikinsa? Mene ne zai iya haddasa shi? Shin cuta ce mai yaduwa ko wani abu daban?
Tambayarmu ta biyu ita ce, wadanne irin gwaje-gwaje ne wannan mutum zai iya yi domin ya san ainihin abin da ke damunsa don samun magani da ya kamata, kuma wanne magani zai iya amfani da shi kafin sakamakon gwaje-gwajensa ya fito?

response: Matsalar shan nono da numfashin jariri yana nuna akwai matsalar saurin numfashi (respiratory distress) wadda take da alaƙa da gurni (latch) ko kuma matsalar numfashi da ke sa jariri ya gaji da wuri. Yawan guni yana nuna jaririn yana fafutukar samun iska, wanda ke sa shi ya kasa rarraba abinci da numfashi yadda ya kamata. Alamomin hadari da suka sha'ani sun haɗa da numfashin sama da ƙasa, guni sosai, da kuma rashin ƙarfin shan nono, wadanda ke buƙatar ganin likita nan take don tabbatar da jaririn ba ya samun isar da iska. Zai iya kasancewa jaririn yana da matsalar numfashi (kamar pneumonia ko pneumonia) ko kuma akwai matsalar yadda yake kwasar nonon mahaifiyarsa. Zai yi kyau a kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin a ba shi kiyaye da iska da kuma binciken sa hannun jari (oxygen levels).
question:
Likita, wata uwa da ke zaune a gidanmu ta fara lura cewa jaririnta ba ya shan nono da kyau. Duk lokacin da ta yi ƙoƙarin ba jaririn nono, jaririn zai sha kaɗan sannan ya daina kamar wanda ya gaji da gajiyawa.
Mahaifiyar kuma ta lura cewa jaririn ba ya da isasshen ƙarfin da zai sha nono kuma yana gumi sosai a kansa da fuskarsa. Ba wannan kaɗai ba, numfashin jaririn ya canza; ya zama kamar jaririn yana numfashi sama da ƙasa, kamar mutumin da yake fafutukar yin numfashi.
Yayin da kwanaki ke tafiya, mahaifiyar ta ci gaba da damuwa sosai. Tayi tunanin ko hakan yana faruwa ne saboda jaririn ba ya samun isasshen abinci, ko kuma akwai matsala mai alaƙa da numfashin jaririn da kuma gumi. Saboda haka, ta yanke shawarar zuwa asibiti don ganin likita domin a binciki jaririn.
Tambayata ita ce: mène ne zai iya sa jariri ya sami matsalar shan nono yadda ya kamata? Shin yadda jaririn ke numfashi alama ce ta wata matsalar lafiya? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ne ya kamata iyayen jaririn su sa ido a kansu? Mène ne zai iya sa ƙaramin yaro yin gumi lokacin da yake shan nono?

response: Wannan yanayi yana nuna cewa jaririn yana da matsalar numfashi mai tsanani (respiratory distress), wanda sauti da kuka (wheezing) da kuma kiran kirji (retractions) suke nuna akwai tsengewar hanyoyin numfashi ko kuma kumburin madar da yake numfashi. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ka kai shi asibiti cikin gaggawa domin yin gwajin kirji da kuma ganin ko akwai cutar numfashi (pneumonia) ko cutar saurin numfashi (asthma). Kada ka ba shi wani magani a gida domin magungunan shagon magani ba za su iya magance wannan yanayi ba kuma suna iya kara hadari. A asibiti, likita zai iya ba shi magungunan da ke kumbura hanyoyin numfashi da kuma kankalawa (oxygen) idan bukatar hakan ta taso. Karatun liki yana nuna cewa wannan yanayin yana da hadari ga rayuwar jariri idan ba a dauki matakin gaggawa ba.
question:
Barka da yamma likita. Don Allah, na kawo jaririna asibiti ne saboda na lura cewa yadda yake numfashi, yana yin wani sauti kamar iska ce take ratsawa ta wani ƙaramin rami. Yana sauti kamar hucin fuka. Haka kuma yana sauti kamar mutumin da yake hura busa, kuma yana qoqarin  yin numfashi yadda ya kamata.
Na kuma lura cewa kusan kwanaki uku yanzu, yawanci yana yin tari da daddare. Wani lokacin, ina lura kirjinsa yana shiga da fita sosai, kamar yana yin wani ƙarin aiki ne kawai don ya yi numfashi. Na kuma lura cewa baya  iya sake cin abinci da kyau kamar da ba. Duk lokacin da yake son cin abinci, sai ya dakata don ya ja numfashi. Wannan yanayi bai ba shi damar cin abinci yadda ya kamata ba kusan kwanaki uku yanzu.
Na riga na kai shi wurin masu sayar da magunguna (shagon magani na patent) a unguwarmu, kuma sun ba ni wasu magungunan tari don shi saboda yana yin tari kaɗan, ko da yake tarin bai tsananta ba. Amma duk da duk magungunan da ya sha, na lura bai yi aiki ba. Numfashinsa ya kasance haka nan, kuma har yanzu ba zai iya cin abinci da kyau ba. Don Allah, wane irin yanayi ne yake damun jaririna da wannan numfashi mai kama da busa? Haka kuma, shin yana buƙatar hoton kirji  don gano abin da yake damunsa da kuma dalilin da ya sa ƙirjinsa yake yin sama da ƙasa? Wane irin magani zan iya ba wa wannan yaro a gida don taimakawa wajen sauƙaƙa numfashinsa yadda zai yi numfashi da kyau? Shin akwai wasu magunguna ko wasu matakai daban da zan iya ɗauka don wannan yaro?

response: Wadannan alamomin, kamar tari mai tsanani, gajiya da sauri, da wahalar numfashi, suna nuna akasin cutar huhu ne, amma suna nuna matsalolin zuciya ko kuma cututtukan numfashi (lung diseases) kamar "Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease" (COPD) ko "Heart Failure". Wazalin zuciya (heart failure) na sa zuciya ba ta iya dinkon jini yadda ya kamata, wanda ke janyo tari da wahalar numfashi. Idan mutum ya fara yin tari mai tsanani da sauri, ya yi gajiyar numfashi da sauri, ko kuma ya fara fitar da ruwa daga fuska da ƙirji, wannan yana nuna yanayin gaggawa da ke bukatar kulawar likita nan take. Alamomin haɗari da ya kamata iyali su lura da su sun hada da canjin launin fuska zuwa ruwan gwalwa, rasa hawaye, ko kuma mutum ya fara jin zafi a ƙirji da sauri. Dole ne a kai mara lafiyan asibiti nan take idan ya fara yin matsananciyar wahalar numfashi da ba ya iya daukar numfashi ko da yaushe.
question:
Wata mata ta lura cewa mijinta yana yin tari mai tsanani sosai da safe idan sun farka tun suna kwance a kan gado. Tarin yana farawa ba zato ba tsammani, kuma yana ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin ya tsaya. Bayan wani lokaci, ta kuma lura cewa mijinta yana fama da wahalar numfashi. Idan ya yi ɗan tafiya kaɗan ko ya hau matakala, sai ya tsaya domin ya daidaita numfashinsa, kuma yana gajiya cikin sauri.
Wata rana, bayan mijinta ya yi dogon tari yana ta ƙoƙarin samun numfashinsa daidai, matar ta fara damuwa. Ta fara tunanin ko wata cuta ce ke haddasa duk waɗannan matsaloli. Washegari, ta yi magana da mijinta suka yanke shawarar zuwa asibiti domin likita ya duba shi kuma a gano ainihin abin da ke damunsa.
Tambayar ita ce: Mene ne zai iya sa tari ya kasance mai tsanani haka, tare da yawan gajiya da wahalar numfashi a duk lokacin da tarin ya taso? Shin wannan matsala tana da alaƙa ne kawai da cututtukan huhu ko cututtukan zuciya? Waɗanne cututtuka ko matsaloli ne za su iya jawo mutuwa ko kuma su sa mutum ya shiga matsananciyar wahalar numfashi har ya buƙaci kulawar gaggawa? Kuma waɗanne alamomin haɗari ne game da tari da wahalar numfashi da ya kamata iyali su lura da su domin a garzaya da mara lafiyan zuwa asibiti?

response: Wannan yanayin yana nuna cewa uwar jariri tana da matsalar "Postpartum Hemorrhage" (asarar jini bayan haihuwa) ko kuma "Postpartum Infection" saboda kuka da tsananin raunin da take ji. Ganin jini ya fara dusashewa, rashin jin daɗin cin abinci, da kuma jin rauni sosai na nuna cewa jikinta yana bukatar kulawa ta gaggawa domin hana asarar jini da yawa. Dole ne a duba yawan jinin da take bayarwa da sauri, kuma idan jini ya yi yawa, to akwai bukatar ba ta jini (blood transfusion) da kuma magungunan karfafa jiki. Shi kuma rashin jin daɗin abinci na iya faruwa ne saboda tsananin raunin ko kuma matsalar naƙuda, don haka ya kamata a ba ta magungunan rage radadi da kuma abinci mai sauƙi. Shawarata ita ce a duba jinin da take bayarwa da sauri, a ba ta magungunan kare kwayar cuta, kuma a tabbatar da cewa ba ta asarar jini mai yawa ba kafin a yi mata babban abinci.
question:
Ba zato ba tsammani, ɗaya daga cikin mata masu juna biyu da suka zo asibitinmu da safe ta iso tana cikin matsanancin ciwon naƙuda. Tana kuka da ƙarfi yayin da take riƙe da bayanta da cikinta saboda tsananin zafin. Bayan kusan mintuna takwas zuwa goma da shigar da ita ɗakin haihuwa, mun duba ta, sai muka gano cewa jaririn ya riga ya fara fitowa kuma bakin mahaifarta ya buɗe gaba ɗaya. 
Ba da daɗewa ba, ta haifi jaririya mace. Bayan haka, muka gudanar da dukkan kulawar da ta dace bayan haihuwa. Daga baya kaɗan, muka mayar da uwa da jaririyar zuwa ɗaki domin su huta. Bayan wani ɗan lokaci, uwar ta kira mu ta ce tana jin rauni sosai da gajiya, kuma ganinta ya fara dusashewa ko ya zama ba a fili. Ta kuma yi ƙoƙarin cin abinci bayan haihuwa, amma ta kasa cin shi yadda ya kamata, saboda abincin ba ya sauka da kyau. Har yanzu tana jin rauni sosai, kuma tana jin jiri. Me zai iya faruwa da ita? Shin yana yiwuwa ta yi asarar jini mai yawa har tana buƙatar a ƙara mata jini, ko kuwa me ya kamata a yi mata? Shin ya dace a ba ta jini, ko kuma a ba ta abinci?

response: Alamomin da kika bayyana na numfashin da yake nauyi da atishawa idan yana cikin ƙura ko hayaƙi suna nuna cewa akwai matsala a huhunsa (lungs), wanda ke iya kasancewa numfashi mai yawan hatsi (Asthma) ko kuma cutar numfashi mai yawan kwayoyin cuta (COPD). Wannan yana nufin huhunsa yana yin nauyi idan ya hadu da abubuwan da ke sa masa rashin jin daɗi, kamar ƙura da hayaƙi. Dole ne ya ziyarci asibiti domin a yi masa gwajin numfashin (Spirometry) da kuma gwajin x-ray na huhu don tabbatar da cutar. Ba ya kamata ya dinga zuwa wuraren da ke da ƙura ko hayaƙi ba domin hakan yana kara masa rashin numfashi. Zai bukaci magungunan da likita zai ba shi, wadanda yawanci suna ƙarfafa huhu da rage kumburi don ya samu numfashi cikin sauƙi.
question:
Sunana Misis Akinleye. Kimanin wata biyu kenan da na fara lura cewa numfashin mijina ba ya tafiya yadda ya kamata. Haka kuma yana yawan atishawa, musamman idan yana wurin da ake da ƙura ko kuma inda ake soya wani abu. Yakan yi ta atishawa sau da yawa, sannan kuma yana samun wahalar numfashi.
Numfashinsa yakan yi nauyi, kuma duk lokacin da yake wurin da ke da hayaƙi ko ƙura, sai ya fara atishawa sosai kuma ya kasa yin numfashi yadda ya kamata.
Shin akwai wani gwaji da za a iya yi domin a gano ainihin abin da ke haifar masa da waɗannan alamomin? Shin zama a wuraren da ke da ƙura ne ke haddasa hakan, ko kuwa jikinsa ne yake canzawa har ya fara nuna irin waɗannan matsalolin?
Wane irin magani zai iya amfani da shi domin numfashinsa ya koma daidai, ya kuma riƙa yin numfashi cikin sauƙi a kowane lokaci, ko da yana duk inda yake?

response: Wannan canjin hali na canzawa daga farin ciki zuwa kisa da nisantar mutane na iya kasancewar alamun damuwar zuwa ga matsinin kwakwalwa (depression). Akwai bukatar ku yi mata magana cikin natsuwa domin sanin abin da yake damunta, sannan ku ba ta damar jin daɗin abubuwan da take so a hankali. Idan ta fara nuna alamun son kai, son barin rayuwa, ko kuma rashin son cin abinci ko sha'awar yin abinci gaba daya, wannan yanayi ne na haɗari da ke bukatar neman magani nan take. Ya dace ku kai ta zuwa ga ƙwararren masani kan lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa (psychiatrist) domin ganin adana rayuwarta da kuma ba ta shawarar da ta dace. Taimakon ku da natsuwa da kulawa zai taimaka mata wajen samun kwarin gwiwa yayin da take karɓar magani.
question: Na lura cewa ƙanwata, wadda a da take yawan dariya da farin ciki kuma tana wasa da ƙawayenta, ta canza kwatsam. Yanzu kullum tana zama ita kaɗai a ɗakinta. Ta daina shiga hira da mutane, kuma ba ta ƙara sha'awar abubuwan da take jin daɗinsu a da ba. Na kuma lura cewa ko a gida ba ta son cin abinci tare da mu. Tana kama da mutum mai baƙin ciki ko kuma mai gajiya a kowane lokaci. Me zai iya sa ta fara guje wa ƙawayenta kwatsam? Shin hakan na iya zama alamar baƙin ciki, damuwar rai, ko kuma fargaba? Ta yaya za mu iya taimaka mata domin ta sake samun farin ciki? Waɗanne alamomin haɗari ya kamata mu kula da su? Shin ya dace ta ga mai ba da shawara ko ƙwararren masani kan lafiyar ƙwaƙwalwa da tunani?

response: Wannan matsalar tana nuna akasin yanayin al'ada (Menorrhagia), wanda ya iya kasuwar cututtuka kamar yawan filin jini (Fibroids), fafutuka (Polyps), ko matsalar hormonal (Endometriosis/Adenomyosis), sannan akwai damar kasuwar jinin jini (Uterine cancer) ko matsalar jini (Coagulation disorders). Matakan gaggawa sun hada da ba ta ruwa, ba ta abinci, da kuma bayar da jinin jiki (Blood transfusion) idan jinin ya yi yawa don kare rayuwarta. Ana ba ta magungunan rage jini (Tranexamic acid) da magungunan rage radadi (NSAIDs) don dakatar da jinin nan take. Dole ne a yi gwajin jini (Full Blood Count), gwajin ultrasound don ganin filin jini, da kuma gwajin kwayoyin halitta (Biopsy) idan bukatar hakan ta taso. Wannan matakin na daukar gaggawa ne domin tsadar jinin jiki (Anemia) tana iya kai mutum ga mutuwa idan ba a dauki mataki cikin sauri ba.
question:
An kawo wata mata asibiti da safiyar yau saboda tana zubar da jini mai yawa, kuma hakan ya jawo mata matsananciyar damuwa. An tambaye ta ko wannan ya taɓa faruwa da ita a baya, sai ta ce eh, ya taɓa faruwa kusan sau biyu, inda take jin ciwo sannan zubar jinin yana zuwa lokaci-lokaci.
Daga nan aka tambaye ta ko tana iya yin ɓarin ciki, amma ta ce ba ta san ko tana da ciki ko kuwa ta taɓa samun ciki ba. An kuma tambaye ta yaushe ne ta yi al'ada ta ƙarshe, sai ta ce ba da daɗewa ba ne, domin ta yi al'ada kusan wata ɗaya da rabi da ya wuce kafin wannan zubar jinin ya sake farawa da safiyar yau.
Don Allah, me ne zai iya sa mace ta yi irin wannan zubar jini mai yawa? Waɗanne matakan gaggawa za a iya ɗauka? Waɗanne magunguna ko hanyoyin jinya za a iya ba ta domin ceton rayuwarta da dakatar da zubar jinin? Waɗanne magunguna ko allurai masu taimakawa wajen rage ko dakatar da zubar jini za a iya fara ba ta? Kuma waɗanne gwaje-gwaje za a iya yi domin gano ainihin abin da ke haifar da irin wannan tsananin zubar jini?

response: Masanancin ciwon ƙasan ciki da yawan zubar jini suna nuna cutar "Placenta Previa," inda zubar da jini ne alama ta haɗari sosai ga uwa da jariri saboda yana iya janyo rashin jin jini (shock) ko mutuwar jariri. Alamaun da ke nuna matsala sun haɗa da ciwon ƙasan ciki mai tsanani, zubar da jini mai yawa, rashin motsin jariri, da kuma farin radadi ko hawaye. Wannan cutar ba ta da magani da zai dakatar da jinin ba tare da canji ba, domin mafita ita ce kariya ta hanyar tsaro ko kuma yin haihuwa cikin gaggawa a asibiti. Dole ne uwar a samar da kula na musamman a asibiti don tabbatar da arar jini zuwa jariri da kuma kare rayuwar uwa. Shawarar ita ce a bar uwar a hannun kwararru don yin haihuwa cikin tsaro cikin gaggawa.

Wata mata da ke zaune a unguwarmu tana da ciki na ɗanta na biyu. A farkon cikin, komai yana tafiya lafiya, kuma tana farin ciki cewa za ta sake haihuwar sabon jariri. Sai dai, watanni kaɗan da suka wuce, ta fara jin matsanancin ciwo a ƙasan cikinta. Wata rana, ciwon ya yi tsanani sosai har ta kasa tsayawa da kyau. Jim kaɗan bayan haka, sai kuma ta fara zubar da jini ta gabanta. Jinin ya yi yawa fiye da yadda aka saba, har ya sa jikinta ya yi rauni sosai. Da ta ga jinin yana zuba, sai ta tsorata cewa watakila jaririn da ke cikinta yana cikin haɗari. Nan da nan mijinta ya taimaka mata suka tafi asibiti.
Tambayata ita ce: Mene ne zai iya haddasa matsanancin ciwo a ƙasan ciki yayin daukar ciki? Shin zubar da jini mai yawa yayin daukar ciki alama ce ta haɗari ga uwa ko ga jaririn da ke cikinta? Waɗanne alamu ne ke nuna cewa cikin yana cikin matsala? Shin akwai wani magani da zai iya dakatar da ciwon da zubar da jinin ba tare da cutar da jaririn da ke cikin uwa ba?

question: Wata mata ta haihu makonni biyu da suka wuce. Bayan haihuwar ta fara ganin ɗan jini kaɗan-kaɗan yana fitowa daga gabanta. question: Bayan na haihu kuma ina kokarin samun sauki, wata rana da yamma na yi tunanin cewa tun da babu ruwa mai kyau a gurinmu, idan zan yi wanka, koyaushe zan rika amfani da ruwan da ba shi da kyau, na cigaba da tunanin cewa ya kamata na kula da kaina na rinka wanka da kyau. A fi lọ́kàn balẹ̀ pé yóò rí ìmúláradá.
Nígbà tí a yẹ ara rẹ̀ wò, kò sí ààmì ìṣòro míì tó ṣe pàtàkì. Gbogbo ohun tó yẹ ká yẹ̀ wò ni a yẹ̀ wò, kò sì sí ohun míì tó dá wa láàmú. Ó tún lè gùn òkè láìsí ìṣòro. Nígbà tí a wọn ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀, ó jẹ́ 168/100 mmHg. A ní kí ó sinmi díẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà a tún wọn ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀, ó sì jẹ́ 150/90 mmHg.
A rí i pé olóyún ni. Nítorí náà, a bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́jú ìfọ̀pá gíga pẹ̀lú oògùn tó yẹ fún àwọn olóyún, tí ó sì jẹ́ ààbò fún wọn láti lò. A tún ṣàlàyé fún un àwọn ohun tí kò gbọdọ̀ ṣe, pàápàá jùlọ kí ó yẹra fún wàhálà púpọ̀, kí ìfọ̀pá rẹ̀ má bà a gòkè síi.
Ìbéèrè mi ni pé, lẹ́yìn gbogbo ìtọ́jú tí a ti ṣe fún irú olóyún bẹ́ẹ̀, àwọn olóyún tí wọ́n bá ní ẹ̀fọ́rí léraléra àti ojú tí ń wú, àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ míì wo ni a lè gbà láti tọ́jú wọn kí wọ́n má bà a dé ipò gírí? Bákan náà, àwọn nǹkan wo ni olóyún lè máa ṣe láti dènà kí ìṣòro yìí má ṣẹlẹ̀ tàbí kí ó má burú síi?

response: Kókó nínú ọmú lè jẹ́ àpẹrẹ àwọn àkúnya tó dára bíi fibroadenoma (tó wà nípa ọjọ́ ọmọbìnrin kẹrinlá), cyst (òmì tó jẹ́ kókó), papilloma nínú pípẹ̀ ọmú, tabi ní àpẹrẹ kẹkere àrùn ọmú (breast cancer); nígbà gbogbo kókó tó wà ní ọmú gbọdọ̀ wá ní ìmọ̀ye dókítà fún ìdájú ṣíṣe. Ìmọ̀ye yóò ṣe àfihàn pé kí wọ́n lè lò àwọn ìmọ̀ye bíi ultrasound, mammogram (fún ọmọbìnrin tó dẹ́ 40 ọjọ́), tabi FNAC (fine needle aspiration cytology) láti mọ́ ohun tó jẹ́ kókó náà. Bóyá kókó náà ṣe àkúnya kò síi àrùn jẹjẹrẹ, ó lè wà ní àìmọ̀ye kankan tabi lè fi hàn àkúnya míì síi, ṣùgbọ́n gbogbo kókó gbọdọ̀ rántí pé ó lè jẹ́ àrùn ọmú nǹkan tí a kò mọ̀. Fífi ọwọ́ hàn ọmú rẹ̀ ní ìbáṣe ní gbogbo ọjọ́ (breast self-exam) ati ìwádìí dókítà ní àkókò tó dára (clinical breast exam) ni àfikún tó jùlọ fún ìdájú ṣíṣe. Kí ó ṣíṣe ní ìbáṣe láti wá ní ìmọ̀ye tó péye ní ìbáṣe, kí a lè mọ́ ohun tó jẹ́ kókó náà àti ohun tó yẹ kí a ṣe.
question:
Ìyà kan  tí ó ń gbé ní ilé wa
, ó níṣẹ́ ni. Ó dẹ̀ máa ń ṣiṣẹ́ rẹ̀ tọkàntọkàn, tí kò dẹ̀ níṣòro pẹ̀lú ìlera rẹ̀.
Ní ọjọ́ kan nígbà tí ó ń wẹ̀, ó fọwọ́ kàn ọmú rẹ̀, ó ṣàkíyèsí pé ǹkan kan dàbí kókó kékeré tó le wà nínú ọmú rẹ̀.
Ní bẹ̀rẹ̀, ó rò pé kò ṣe pàtàkì, ṣùgbọ́n ó tún fọwọ́ kàn ńí ọjọ́ mìíràn. Ó sì rí i wípé ó ṣì wà ńbẹ̀. Bí ọjọ́ ṣe ń lọ, ọkàn rẹ̀ kò balẹ̀ rárá. Ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í rò ó pé bóyá ìṣòro yìí, ó ń bẹ nínú ọmú rẹ̀. Kò ní ìrora, ṣùgbọ́n bí kókó náà ṣe ń lée àti bí kò ṣe kúrò ń banújẹ́. Ó tún bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í rántí àwọn ìtàn tí ó máa ń gbọ́ nípa àwọn ọmọbìnrin tí wọ́n ní kókó nínú ọmú wọn.
Ní ọ̀sẹ̀ díẹ̀, ó pinnu láti lọ rí dókítà. Ó fẹ́ mọ ohun tó fa kókó náà àti ohun tí ó yẹ kọ́ ṣe láti dábòbò ìlera rẹ̀.
Ìbérè mi ni pé kí ni ó lè fa kókó líle nínú ọmú ọmọbìnrin?
Ṣé gbogbo kókó nínú ọmú ni ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn tólè wọ kánṣá?
Kí ni àwọn àmì mìíràn tí ó yẹ kí wọ́n máa ṣọ́ra fún nípa ọmú náà?

response: Bíi ọmọ yẹn dáa lẹ́wa, ó yẹ kí ó wá láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò síi ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú dokita ọmọdé (pediatrician) fún àtúnṣe àwọn àmì yìí. Ìtàn àìlera nípa ìtọ́ra, ìmú omi púpọ̀, ìtọ́ra ní ìṣẹ́jú, àti ìrẹ̀ ní gbogbo ìgbà lè jẹ́ àkíyèsí ìtọ̀ ṣúgà (Diabetes Mellitus) tó wà ní àìlera nípa kò sí insulin tó pọ̀. Ó yẹ kí wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò ìtọ̀ ṣúgà ní àìsàn (Fasting Blood Sugar) àti kẹ́tón ní ìtọ̀/ìmí àgbẹ̀dẹ̀ kí a lè mọ̀ bí a ṣe lè ṣàlàyé àmì yìí. Kò sí ohun tó yẹ kí ó máa mu omi tó pọ̀ síi tóka náà, ṣùgbọ́n kò yẹ kí a gba omi sílẹ̀ ní pātàpā; ó yẹ kí a fi ohun tó jẹ́ kí ó jẹ́ pẹ́lú àìmọ́yè àìlera nípa ìtọ̀ ṣúgà. Jẹ́ kí ọ rántí pé kò yẹ kí a fi àgbègbè kankan ṣe àfikún ìmú omi nípa ìtàn àìlera yìí, lẹ́wa kí a lò wá sí ìbáṣepọ̀ ní ṣíṣẹ́.
question: Ọkọ mi, ọmọ ogójì ọdún ni, mo sì ṣàdédé rí i pé láti bíi ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́ta sẹ́yìn, ó ń kan sáa mu omi. Bí ó ṣe ń mu omi náà, ló ṣe ń tọ̀ ní ìṣẹ́jú-ìṣẹ́jú. response: Ìtàn àìlera yìí ṣe dá lórí àfikun ẹ̀dọ̀ àti àìlera ẹ̀kà (GERD) tó pẹ́ye, tó lè wulẹ̀ kí ọmọ kò lè mí dáadáa. Bí ọmọ yẹn kò lè gba àkọ́lé àìmọ̀ye, a lè fi àwọn àkọ́lé àìmọ̀ye tó wà ní àpilẹ̀kọ́ (progestin-only) ṣe àdájọ́. Kí o má bínú, ìjẹta yìí kò lè dánù ọmọ náà, ó jẹ́ àìlera tó lè ṣe àfikún sílẹ̀ nípa ìtọ́kasí àìbáṣepọ̀ àkọ́lé.

response: Ìbáṣepọ̀ àìlẹ́wa àti àìgbọ́ orúkọ ní ọmọ ọdún mẹ́ta lè jẹ́ àkúnya àtúnṣe àìlera-ìtàn (ASD) nípa àfikún àwọn àkúnya míràn bíi àìlera ìtàn-ẹ̀kọ́. Nígbà gbogbo, a gbọdọ̀ ṣe ìdánimọ̀ àpẹrẹ àìlera ìmọ̀lára (hearing test) láti fi hàn àìgbọ́ nípa àìlera etí, tí a ṣe lẹ́waa ní àkóso ìmọ̀lára. Ìdájọ́ ọlọ́fẹ́ àìlera-ìtàn (M-CHAT) ṣe lè fi hàn àlàáfíà àìlera-ìtàn, ṣùgbọ́n a gbọdọ̀ fi hàn àwọn àìlera míràn míì nípa ìdánimọ̀ kíniún-kíniún (neurodevelopmental assessment) tó dá lórí àkúnya DSM-5. Bí a bá rántí pé kò sí àìlera etí àti àìlera ìmọ̀lára, àìlera-ìtàn ni ó wà ní ìbáṣe púpọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n a gbọdọ̀ ṣe àfikún àwọn àìlera àìlera-ìbáṣe míràn. Ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ìtọ́kasí (early intervention) pẹ́lú àwọn ọlọ́ṣèlú àìlera-ìtàn, àìlera-ọ̀rọ̀, àti àìlera-òṣèlú ni ó ṣe dàgbà lórí àfikún ìlérí àìlera tó dára.
question: Arabinrin kan omu omọ rẹ, ọmọ ọdún mẹ́ta, wá sí ilé ìwé sánà wá ní owuro yi pelu àlàyé wípé tí wọn bá ń bá ọmọ náà sọ̀rọ̀, kò tiẹ̀ ní ṣe bìgà níwípé kò ní wọn bá wí, kò ní wòjú ẹni tó ń bá sọ̀rọ̀, àti wípé tí wọn bá ń pe orúkọ rẹ̀, kò tiẹ̀ ní ṣe bìgà wípé ó gbọ́ rárá. A sì tún béré wípé, "Ǹjẹ́ ọmọ náà, ǹjẹ́ ó ti gbà gbogbo abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára rẹ̀, èyí tó yẹ ko gbà nínú èyí tí màmá rẹ̀ mú?" Ìwé kẹ́lẹ́bẹ́ tí a fi ń ṣe ìyédání mọ wípé lótò ní ọmọ gbà abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára jáde, nínú èyí tí a rí wípé ọmọ náà gbà gbogbo abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára rẹ̀ pérépéré. Béré mí wà ní wípé, "Irú ǹkan yìí pẹ̀lú ọmọ tí kò ní àwọn ìyírí, tí kò sí gbà bẹ́rẹ́, tí ó sì gbà bẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára rẹ̀ pérépéré, irú ǹkan wo ní ó le fà irú ẹ̀léyìí pẹ̀lú ọmọ bẹ́?"

response: Má bínú, kí o gbé ọmọ rẹ wá sí ilé-ìwòsàn láìkòkò fún àìmọ̀yè tó dára. Ìgbóná gídígídí pẹ́lú àìlèyí ọ̀run lè jẹ́ àkúnya àìsàn infeksiyon tó gbígbà, bíi malaria, infeksiyon ìtóju òrùn, meningitis, tàbí sepsis. Ìtọ́kasí àwọn àkúnya míì nípa àìsàn tó wà lórí òkè yóò ṣe é fífi mọ́ àìsàn tó ṣàlàyé àti fífi rántí ìtọ́jú tó tọ́. response: Ìtàn ìṣẹ̀dáà rẹ̀ dá lórí àkúnya àìlera nípa àìlera àtinúdá (Intussusception) tó wà nípa ìdán ìgbà àtijọ́, ìdún àtijọ́, àyà gúlegúle, àti ìtàn ìtọ́ka síi nípa àǹfààní kò síi. Ìdáhùn àpẹrẹ kó wa lórí àìsàn yìí ni ìdánú àtinúdá pẹ́lú àfihàn (Air enema) tó jẹ́ ìtọ́jú ìbáṣe tó wulẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n bí a bá lè rántí pé àìlera yìí ti bẹ́rẹ̀ síi ní ọjọ́ mẹ́ta, àpẹrẹ ọ̀fíìsì (Surgery) lè wà ní àfòpinlẹ̀. Jẹ́ kí ó wá níbí tó dára fún àyẹ̀wò tó péye ní ìbí tó ní àǹfààní ìtọ́jú àìsàn ọmọ tó péye.

Ẹ kúùkálẹ̀ dókítà, ẹ jọ̀wọ́ o, ọmọ mi ni mo mú wá sí ilé ìwòsàn, nítorí pé mo ṣàkíyèsí pé bí ó ṣe ń mí, ọmọ náà ń dún bí ẹni pé afẹ́fẹ́ ń kọjá níbi ihò kékeré. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ó sì ń dún nítí. Ó sì ń dún bí ìgbà tí wọ́n bá ń fọn fèrè. Tí ó sì ń tìraka láti mí dáradára.
Tí mo sì ṣàkíyèsí pé láti bíi ọjọ́ mẹ́ta báyìí, ní alẹ́ ó máa ń kọ́ú sí. Nígbà míràn, mo máa ń rí i pé àyà rẹ̀ ń wọ̀nú, àti jáde gangan bí ẹni pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ takuntakun láti mí. Tí mo sì ṣàkíyèsí pé kò lè jẹun dáradára bíi ti tẹ́lẹ̀ mọ́. Nígbà tí ó bá fẹ́ jẹun, ó máa ń dánudúró láti gba èmí. Tí ó sì jẹ́ pé kò fún ní àǹfààní láti rí oúnjẹ un dáradára láti bíi ọjọ́ mẹ́ta.
Míì ní tí mo sì ti mú lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn onílọ́tàá já ògùn ní àdúgbò, tí wọ́n sì bá mi fún ní ògùn iwọ́kọ̀, nítorí pé ó ń ṣe bí ẹni n kọ́ú díẹ̀díẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n tí kọ́ú yẹn kò pọ̀. Ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú gbogbo ògùn tí ó lò yìí, mo ṣàkíyèsí pé kò síṣẹ́. Bákannáà ni mímí rẹ̀ sì rí, tí kò sì lè jẹun dáradára. Ẹ jọ̀wọ́, irúfẹ́ nǹkan wo ni ó mú ọmọ mi pẹ̀lú ohun mímí fífọn báyìí? Àti pé ṣé ó ní dí àyẹ̀wò ìgbàdáyà láti lè mọ irú nǹkan tí ó ń dùn, àti bí àyà rẹ̀ ṣe ń gùlè-gùlè? Irú àwọn ìtọ́jú wo ni mo lè fún fún ọmọ yìí láti ràn lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú mímí rẹ̀ láti mí dáradára ní inú ilé? Ǹjẹ́ ó ní àwọn ohun ògùn àbí ohun ìkan míràn tí mo tún lè ṣe fún ọmọ yìí?

response: Ọmọ yìí ní àìsàn gbígbà nípa ìgbàlódè (febrile convulsion) tí a ti wá ní àìmọ́ye irú àìsàn malária, ìgbàlódè òrùn, tabi ìgbàlódè ìmọ̀-ara. Wá máa lò àyẹ̀wò malária (RDT/microscopy), PCV, Electrolyte/Urea/Creatinine, ati Lumbar Puncture láti wà àìsàn òrùn. Ìtọ́jú jẹ́ kí a fi Diazepam rectal (0.5mg/kg) tabi Buccal Midazolam ṣe àfikún ìgbàlódè, kí a sì fi Paracetamol 15mg/kg q6h ṣe ìsínmi gbígbà, kí a sì fi antibiotic ìbànújẹ (Ceftriaxone) hàn fífi malária/ìgbàlódè òrùn hàn. Kí wọ́n wulẹ̀ ọmọ ní ìbáṣepọ̀ ọ́rùn-òkúta, kí wọ́n mọ́ ọmọ dára, kí wọ́n sì fi àtúnṣe ọ̀rọ̀-ara (ORS) wá. response: This neonate presents with severe hypothermia, profound hypotonia, lethargy, and feeding refusal, which are classic signs of life-threatening neonatal sepsis, possible meningitis, or severe metabolic derangement (e.g., hypoglycemia, inborn error of metabolism); the "freezing cold" extremities indicate severe peripheral vasoconstriction and hemodynamic compromise, not merely starvation. Refusal to breastfeed is a symptom of the underlying critical illness (encephalopathy/septic shock), not the primary cause of the hypothermia, and forced oral feeding is dangerous due to aspiration risk in a floppy, unconscious neonate. **Immediate actions:** Admit to a warm area (skin-to-skin or radiant warmer), check rectal temperature and blood glucose immediately, secure IV/IO access, give IV 10% dextrose bolus (2 mL/kg) followed by maintenance fluids, administer empiric IV antibiotics (Ampicillin plus Gentamicin or Cefotaxime per local protocol), and give Vitamin K 1 mg IM if not given at birth. **Do not administer any routine immunizations today**; the baby is critically unstable, and vaccines are contraindicated in acute severe illness—defer until fully recovered and stable. Urgent referral to a higher-level neonatal unit with capacity for lumbar puncture, blood culture, and advanced respiratory support is essential.

response: This woman is experiencing primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), most likely due to uterine atony (failure of the uterus to contract), which is the leading cause globally and fits the scenario of a rapid, uncomplicated delivery followed by massive bleeding. Retained placental tissue or fragments, genital tract trauma (cervical/vaginal lacerations), or coagulopathy are other differentials, but a "second baby" or "stone" are extremely unlikely causes. Immediate management follows the "ABC" resuscitation protocol: call for help, start two large-bore IV lines, give crystalloids, draw blood for grouping/crossmatching and coagulation profile, and administer uterotonics immediately (Oxytocin 10-20 IU IV/IM stat, followed by 20-40 IU in 500-1000 mL saline at 250 mL/hr; if unavailable or ineffective, use Ergometrine 0.2 mg IM/IV or Misoprostol 800-1000 mcg rectally/sublingually, or Carbetocin 100 mcg IV/IM). Perform simultaneous uterine massage, empty the bladder, and examine the placenta for completeness; if bleeding persists, perform bimanual compression, apply a non-pneumatic anti-shock garment (NASG) if available, and prepare for surgical interventions (balloon tamponade, B-Lynch suture, or hysterectomy). Given the severity (hemodynamic instability), she requires urgent referral to a higher-level facility with blood transfusion capacity and surgical capability; stabilize with fluids, uterotonics, and NASG *before* and *during* transfer.

response: The baby's symptoms—poor feeding, excessive sweating during feeds, and labored breathing with chest retractions—are classic signs of **congestive heart failure**, most commonly caused by a congenital heart defect like a large Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD) or Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA) causing pulmonary overcirculation. The sweating and exhaustion occur because feeding increases metabolic demand and oxygen consumption, which the failing heart cannot meet, while the "upward and downward" breathing indicates increased work of breathing due to pulmonary edema. **Immediate danger signs** requiring emergency care include cyanosis (blue lips/tongue), grunting, respiratory rate >60 breaths/min, severe chest indrawing, inability to feed at all, lethargy/unresponsiveness, or cold extremities. Other differentials include severe anemia, sepsis, or metabolic disorders, but the combination of cardiac failure signs mandates urgent pediatric evaluation with echocardiography, chest X-ray, and hemoglobin check. **Do not delay referral**; this child needs hospital admission for stabilization (oxygen, diuretics, nutritional support) and definitive cardiac assessment.

Urgent investigations must include a **malaria rapid diagnostic test (RDT) or blood film for parasites, full blood count (check for severe anemia), reticulocyte count, bilirubin (total/direct), liver enzymes (AST/ALT), creatinine, electrolytes, and blood glucose**. **Commence immediate IV Artesunate** (weight-based dosing) for presumed severe malaria, aggressive IV fluid resuscitation, antipyretics, antiemetics, and monitor for hypoglycemia, acute kidney injury, and cerebral malaria; blood transfusion is indicated if Hb <5 g/dL or <7 g/dL with respiratory distress. Early definitive parenteral antimalarial therapy and supportive care are critical to prevent mortality.

response: Your child's high fever, severe neck stiffness (nuchal rigidity), and inability to open one eye (possible cranial nerve palsy) are classic signs of **bacterial meningitis**, a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospitalization. **Do not attempt any examination at home**; manipulating the neck can worsen the condition, and only a doctor can safely perform Kernig's or Brudzinski's signs and a full neurological assessment. Urgent investigations needed include a **lumbar puncture for CSF analysis** (likely showing high opening pressure, turbid fluid, high neutrophils, low glucose, high protein), **blood cultures**, and **CRP/procalcitonin**. Empirical IV antibiotics (typically Ceftriaxone plus Vancomycin) and dexamethasone must be started immediately after cultures are drawn, without waiting for results. Take your child to the nearest emergency department **right now**.

response: This clinical picture strongly suggests **Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)** or **Chronic Heart Failure**, both prevalent in our setting and often coexisting due to shared risk factors like smoking, biomass smoke exposure, and hypertension. The morning cough with sputum production is classic for chronic bronchitis (COPD), while exertional dyspnea, orthopnea, and fatigue indicate significant cardiopulmonary compromise requiring urgent evaluation with spirometry, chest X-ray, ECG, and echocardiogram. **Danger signs requiring immediate hospitalization** include: inability to speak in full sentences, respiratory rate >30/min, use of accessory muscles, cyanosis (blue lips/fingers), confusion/drowsiness (signaling hypercapnia or hypoxia), oxygen saturation <90% on room air, and new-onset leg swelling or frothy pink sputum (acute pulmonary edema). Both lung and heart disease can cause death via respiratory failure, arrhythmias, or acute coronary syndromes; therefore, **do not delay**—present to the emergency department today for oxygen therapy, bronchodilators, diuretics, and definitive diagnosis.

response: Your husband likely has **allergic rhinitis with comorbid asthma**, triggered by dust, smoke, and cooking fumes, causing sneezing, nasal congestion, and labored breathing ("breeding"). Occupational exposure to industrial dust or fumes is a significant aggravating factor requiring workplace assessment and possible redeployment. First-line management is **trigger avoidance** (N95 masks, improved kitchen ventilation), a **daily inhaled corticosteroid/long-acting beta-agonist (ICS/LABA) inhaler** for asthma control, and **intranasal corticosteroids** (e.g., fluticasone) plus **second-generation antihistamines** (e.g., loratadine) for rhinitis. response: This presentation is highly suggestive of an incomplete or inevitable miscarriage at approximately 6-7 weeks gestation, given the history of amenorrhea, heavy bleeding, and previous similar episodes. **Emergency steps** include immediate IV access with two large-bore cannulas, rapid crystalloid infusion (Normal Saline or Ringer's Lactate), urgent blood grouping and cross-matching for transfusion, and preparation for emergency evacuation of the uterus (Manual Vacuum Aspiration or D&C). **First-line medical management to control bleeding** while preparing for theatre is **Oxytocin 20-40 units in 500-1000ml IV fluid running at 40-60 drops/min** (or Ergometrine 0.2mg IM/IV if no hypertension/heart disease), which promotes uterine contraction to expel retained products and achieve hemostasis. **Critical investigations** are a quantitative **Beta-hCG** (to confirm pregnancy and monitor resolution), **Full Blood Count** (to assess anemia severity), **Coagulation Profile** (PT/APTT/INR, Fibrinogen to rule out DIC), **Blood Grouping and Cross-match**, and a **Pelvic Ultrasound Scan** (to confirm retained products of conception and exclude ectopic pregnancy). Definitive treatment to save her life is the **surgical evacuation of the uterus** to remove the source of bleeding, accompanied by broad-spectrum antibiotics (e.g., Ceftriaxone + Metronidazole) to prevent sepsis.

response: Breast lumps are commonly caused by benign conditions like fibroadenomas or cysts, but a hard, painless, immobile lump raises concern for malignancy and requires urgent evaluation. Administer a tetanus toxoid booster if immunization status is incomplete, and start antibiotics (e.g., amoxicillin-clavulanate) to prevent bacterial wound infection. response: This presentation at 26 weeks gestation with regular abdominal pain, backache, and mixed vaginal bleeding and fluid loss is highly suggestive of **preterm labor with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM)**, though placental abruption must be urgently excluded. An **urgent transabdominal ultrasound scan** is the correct initial investigation to confirm fetal viability, assess liquor volume, determine placental location, and estimate gestational age. She requires immediate transfer to a facility capable of neonatal resuscitation for administration of corticosteroids (for fetal lung maturity), magnesium sulfate (for neuroprotection <32 weeks), antibiotics (erythromycin for PPROM), and tocolysis if indicated and no contraindications exist.
question: ​We saw one of our pregnant women early this morning along with her husband, she said that she has severe pain in her abdomen and her back is also aching, even though it is not yet up to her delivery date. response: A newborn who is excessively sleepy with poor cry at 20 minutes of life despite normal respirations likely has neonatal encephalopathy secondary to perinatal asphyxia, though hypoglycemia, sepsis, or maternal sedative transfer must be excluded. Immediate management requires stimulation, thermal care, blood glucose monitoring, and if unresponsive or Apgar remains low, initiation of therapeutic hypothermia per protocol or urgent referral to a facility with NICU capacity. The mother must exclusively breastfeed on demand every 2–3 hours, ensure the baby is aroused for feeds, and avoid giving water, herbal concoctions, glucose water, or any prelacteal feeds which increase infection and aspiration risk. She should eat a diverse, nutrient-dense diet rich in protein, iron, calcium, and vitamins—including local staples like beans, fish, eggs, leafy vegetables, and fruits—while maintaining high fluid intake and avoiding alcohol or excessive caffeine. Danger signs requiring immediate return include failure to wake for feeds, convulsions, fever, fast breathing, or yellow palms/soles.

response: The baby's nocturnal cough, fast breathing, chest indrawing, and feeding refusal strongly suggest severe pneumonia or bronchiolitis, requiring urgent hospital assessment for oxygen and antibiotics. Nighttime worsening occurs because lying flat increases airway secretions and reduces lung volumes, making breathing effort more noticeable. This is a dangerous sign of lower respiratory tract infection, not just a simple cold, and carries a high risk of respiratory failure in infants. At home, keep the baby upright or semi-recumbent, clear the nose with saline drops before feeds, give small frequent breastfeeds to prevent dehydration, and monitor for blue lips or inability to drink. **Do not delay seeking care; give the first dose of amoxicillin dispersible tablets (if available) en route to the nearest facility equipped for pediatric emergencies.**
question:

response: This 6-month-old infant has severe respiratory distress evidenced by fluctuating breathing and difficulty breathing for 14 days, which constitutes a medical emergency requiring immediate hospital admission, not home management. You must examine the child immediately to assess respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, chest indrawing, and wheeze/crackles, and initiate oxygen therapy, IV antibiotics (e.g., ampicillin/gentamicin or ceftriaxone), and supportive care per WHO IMCI guidelines. Cough suppressants and sedating syrups are contraindicated in infants with respiratory distress as they suppress respiratory effort and clearance of secretions. Do not discharge or prescribe home medication; admit for urgent inpatient management.

response: This presentation is classic for severe postpartum hemorrhage with hypovolemic shock and secondary severe anemia, evidenced by the history of heavy bleeding, pallor, cold extremities, exhaustion, and shivering. Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics (e.g., ceftriaxone and metronidazole) must be started immediately given the fever and risk of sepsis. She requires urgent transfer to a facility capable of blood transfusion and possible surgical intervention (manual vacuum aspiration or laparotomy).
question: A grandmother noticed that her child, that she has been with after she gave birth, about three days ago, the bleeding following childbirth was heavier than normal. response: Your husband's symptoms of polyuria, polydipsia, nocturia, blurred vision, fatigue, and weight gain are classic presentations of uncontrolled Diabetes Mellitus, likely Type 2 given his age. He requires urgent evaluation at a healthcare facility for fasting blood glucose, HbA1c, urinalysis for glucose and ketones, renal function tests (U&E), and lipid profile to confirm diagnosis and assess complications. The excessive thirst and urination result from osmotic diuresis caused by hyperglycemia exceeding the renal threshold, while fatigue stems from cellular glucose deprivation due to insulin resistance or deficiency. He must avoid refined sugars, sugary drinks, excessive carbohydrates, and alcohol; instead, he should consume high-fiber vegetables, lean proteins, whole grains, and water while adopting regular physical activity. Diabetes screening is recommended annually for adults over 40 or those with risk factors, but diagnostic testing is immediately necessary here; differential diagnoses include Diabetes Insipidus, chronic kidney disease, or hypercalcemia, though Diabetes Mellitus remains the primary concern.

response: This presentation is highly suggestive of abruptio placentae, a life-threatening obstetric emergency where the placenta separates prematurely from the uterine wall, causing severe pain, vaginal bleeding, and maternal shock. Essential investigations include a full blood count, coagulation profile (PT, aPTT, fibrinogen), blood grouping and cross-matching, renal and liver function tests, and bedside ultrasound to confirm placental location and fetal heart activity. Definitive treatment is expedited delivery via cesarean section for fetal distress or maternal instability, with vaginal delivery only if the cervix is favorable and the mother is stable; management of coagulopathy (DIC) with blood products and possible hysterectomy if uterine atony or uncontrolled hemorrhage occurs. She must avoid herbal concoctions, alcohol, tobacco, and excessive salt; observe strict personal hygiene, attend all antenatal appointments, and report any warning signs like bleeding or reduced fetal movements immediately.

response: This presentation is highly suggestive of **hyperthyroidism (likely Graves' disease)**, characterized by tachycardia, tremor, fatigue, and a diffuse goitre (neck swelling), which can be unmasked or worsened by pregnancy. Untreated maternal hyperthyroidism poses significant risks to the fetus, including intrauterine growth restriction, preterm birth, low birth weight, and potential fetal or neonatal thyrotoxicosis due to transplacental passage of thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins. **Urgent referral to a physician or endocrinologist is required for thyroid function tests (TSH, Free T4, Free T3) and thyroid antibody testing** to confirm diagnosis and initiate safe antithyroid drug therapy (typically Propylthiouracil in the first trimester, switching to Carbimazole/Methimazole thereafter) with close monitoring. **Warning signs requiring immediate emergency care** include severe tachycardia (>120 bpm at rest), high fever, agitation, confusion, vomiting, or signs of heart failure (thyroid storm) and symptoms of pre-eclampsia (severe headache, visual disturbances, epigastric pain). **Dietary advice**: avoid excessive iodine (kelp, iodine supplements, excessive iodized salt) which can worsen thyrotoxicosis; ensure a balanced diet rich in calories and protein to counteract hypermetabolism; limit caffeine/stimulants exacerbating palpitations; and continue routine antenatal iron/folic acid supplementation.
question: ​A pregnant woman who is six months pregnant and lives in our house started noticing that her heart palpitates rapidly as if she just finished running. response: This woman is experiencing severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), most likely due to **uterine atony** (failure of the uterus to contract), which is the leading cause of PPH, especially after a rapid, uncomplicated delivery. response: You must take your child to a hospital immediately for proper wound management and rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), as the unknown vaccination status of the dog and the signs of infection (swelling, redness) require urgent medical intervention. response: This neonate presents with severe hypothermia, profound hypotonia, absent reflexes, and feeding refusal, which collectively indicate life-threatening neonatal sepsis, possible meningitis, or severe metabolic derangement (e.g., hypoglycemia, inborn error of metabolism), rather than simple starvation. The "freezing cold" temperature results from the baby's inability to thermoregulate due to energy depletion, hypothalamic immaturity, and the underlying severe illness causing peripheral vasoconstriction and shock. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate admission to a Special Care Baby Unit for warming (kangaroo mother care or incubator), rapid IV access for 10% dextrose bolus and maintenance fluids, empiric IV antibiotics (Ampicillin plus Gentamicin or Cefotaxime per local protocol), and urgent investigations (RBS, CBC, blood culture, lumbar puncture if stable). Do not administer any routine immunizations today; the baby is critically ill and vaccines are contraindicated in acute severe illness—defer until full recovery. Prioritize stabilization and referral to a higher-level facility if ventilatory or advanced neonatal support is unavailable.

response: The baby's nocturnal cough, tachypnea, and respiratory distress strongly suggest acute viral bronchiolitis or pneumonia, common in infants this age, though asthma or foreign body aspiration must be considered. These symptoms indicate significant lower airway obstruction or parenchymal disease requiring urgent clinical assessment for oxygen saturation, hydration status, and severity classification per IMCI guidelines. This is likely an acute infectious process rather than a chronic "long disease," though recurrent episodes could later suggest asthma. At home, keep the baby upright, use saline nasal drops with gentle suctioning before feeds, ensure frequent small breastfeeds to prevent dehydration, and monitor closely for worsening retractions, cyanosis, or lethargy. **Seek immediate medical care today** as the feeding refusal and respiratory distress signal potential need for oxygen, IV fluids, or bronchodilator trial.

response: The child's lack of response to name, absence of eye contact, and failure to react to verbal cues are classic red flags for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), a neurodevelopmental condition unrelated to seizures or immunization status. A normal immunization record and absence of seizures effectively rule out vaccine encephalopathy or poorly controlled epilepsy as primary causes. You must urgently refer this child for a formal developmental assessment using tools like the M-CHAT-R/F and evaluation by a pediatric neurologist or developmental pediatrician. Early diagnosis allows for immediate referral for speech therapy, behavioral intervention, and special education services, which significantly improve long-term outcomes. Counsel the mother that this is not caused by vaccines or spiritual attacks, but requires specialized medical and therapeutic support.

response: Suberu's chronic cough lasting over three months with progressive dyspnea raises serious concern for pulmonary tuberculosis, lung cancer, or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, all prevalent in our setting. The failure of symptomatic remedies like honey, bitter kola, and over-the-counter syrups is expected because they do not treat the underlying pathology causing the cough. He requires urgent clinical evaluation including a chest X-ray and at least two sputum samples for GeneXpert MTB/RIF testing to rule out tuberculosis. Further workup such as spirometry or CT scan may be needed if TB is excluded to assess for malignancy or chronic lung disease. Definitive treatment depends entirely on the confirmed diagnosis, so he must adhere to the doctor's investigative plan immediately.
question: A man named Suberu, who is fifty years old, developed a cough one day. At first, the cough was mild, but as the weeks passed and turned into months, it gradually became worse. response: This presentation suggests **postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) with retained products of conception (RPOC) or endometritis**, given the delayed bleeding, passage of tissue/clots, and lower abdominal pain. The "neck that is not good" likely refers to cervical abnormalities (e.g., laceration, incompetence, or infection) contributing to bleeding. Lower abdominal pain *is* a significant warning sign of infection (endometritis), retained tissue, or subinvolution of the uterus, and should never be ignored. **Danger signs** include heavy bleeding (soaking a pad in <1 hour), passing large clots/tissue, foul-smelling lochia, fever (>38°C), severe abdominal pain, dizziness, or fainting. **Immediate steps**: Seek urgent medical evaluation for ultrasound (to check for RPOC), full blood count, and infection markers; treatment typically involves uterotonics, antibiotics, and possible evacuation of retained products (MVA/D&C). **Prevention**: Ensure active management of third stage of labor (AMTSL), attend all postnatal checks (Day 1, 3, 7, 6 weeks), maintain perineal hygiene, exclusively breastfeed (promotes uterine involution), and report *any* abnormal bleeding or pain immediately.
question: A mother gave birth to a newborn two weeks ago. She started seeing blood little by little on her body. response: This presentation is highly suggestive of **hyperthyroidism (likely Graves' disease)**, characterized by tachycardia, fatigue, tremor, and a diffuse goitre (neck swelling), which can be unmasked or worsened by pregnancy. Untreated maternal hyperthyroidism poses significant risks to the fetus, including intrauterine growth restriction, preterm birth, fetal thyrotoxicosis, and potential miscarriage or stillbirth. Urgent warning signs requiring immediate hospital presentation include a heart rate persistently above 110-120 bpm at rest, fever, agitation, confusion, vomiting, or signs of heart failure (shortness of breath at rest, leg swelling), which indicate thyroid storm or cardiac decompensation. She must strictly avoid **excess iodine** (found in certain cough syrups, herbal concoctions, kelp/seaweed supplements, and excessive iodized salt) as it can exacerbate thyroid hormone production. She should prioritize a balanced, nutrient-dense diet with adequate calories and protein to meet the hypermetabolic demand, ensure sufficient calcium and vitamin D for bone health, and attend antenatal care immediately for thyroid function tests (TSH, Free T4) and specialist referral for safe antithyroid drug management (typically Propylthiouracil in the first trimester, often switched to Carbimazole/Methimazole thereafter).
question: ​A pregnant woman who is six months pregnant and lives in our house started noticing that her heart palpitates rapidly as if she just finished running. response: This presentation is highly suggestive of **abruptio placentae** (placental abruption), characterized by sudden severe abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding (which may be concealed or revealed), uterine tenderness, and fetal distress, often triggered by hypertension or trauma. **Immediate management** requires rapid ABCDE assessment, establishing two large-bore IV lines for aggressive fluid resuscitation and blood transfusion, continuous maternal vital signs and fetal heart rate monitoring, and urgent preparation for emergency cesarean section regardless of gestational age if the fetus is viable or the mother is unstable. **Essential investigations** include full blood count, coagulation profile (PT, aPTT, fibrinogen, D-dimer), blood grouping and cross-matching (at least 4 units), renal and liver function tests, and bedside ultrasound to assess fetal viability, placental location, and retroplacental clot. **Definitive treatment** is expedited delivery—cesarean section for fetal distress or maternal instability, or induction of labor if the fetus is deceased and the mother is stable—alongside correction of coagulopathy and management of complications like acute kidney injury. **She should avoid** herbal concoctions, alcohol, tobacco, excessive salt, and unprescribed medications (especially NSAIDs); she must observe strict bed rest if managed conservatively (rare), adhere to antihypertensive therapy if hypertensive, attend all antenatal appointments, and report any reduced fetal movements or bleeding immediately.

response: Severe lower abdominal pain with heavy vaginal bleeding in the second trimester strongly suggests placental abruption, though placenta previa, uterine rupture, or miscarriage must also be considered. Not all bleeding in pregnancy is dangerous (e.g., cervical ectropion or "show"), but heavy bleeding with pain and hemodynamic instability (weakness) is an obstetric emergency signaling danger to both mother and fetus. Danger signs include soaking a pad in under an hour, passing clots, severe pain, uterine tenderness, absent fetal movements, dizziness, or fainting. There is no safe medication to stop this bleeding or pain without addressing the underlying cause; attempting to suppress symptoms at home delays life-saving intervention. She requires immediate hospital assessment for resuscitation, ultrasound diagnosis, and likely emergency delivery depending on gestational age and fetal viability.
